abomasnow.name: ABOMASNOW
abomasnow.dex_entry: If it sees any packs of Darumaka going after Snover, it chases them off, swinging its sizable arms like hammers.

abra.name: ABRA
abra.dex_entry: This Pokï¿½mon uses its psychic powers while it sleeps. The contents of Abra's dreams affect the powers that the Pokï¿½mon wields.

absol.name: ABSOL
absol.dex_entry: Long ago, superstitions were spread about it, saying it brought disaster. This fed a hatred of it, and it was driven deep into the mountains.

accelgor.name: ACCELGOR
accelgor.dex_entry: It moves with blinding speed and lobs poison at foes. Featuring Accelgor as a main character is a surefire way to make a movie or comic popular.

aegislash_blade.name: AEGISLASH BLADE
aegislash_blade.dex_entry: This stance is dedicated to offense. It can cleave any opponent with the strength and weight of its steel blade.

aegislash_shield.name: AEGISLASH SHIELD
aegislash_shield.dex_entry: In this defensive stance, Aegislash uses its steel body and a force field of spectral power to reduce the damage of any attack.

aerodactyl.name: AERODACTYL
aerodactyl.dex_entry: A Pokï¿½mon from the age of the dinosaurs. It used its sawlike fangs to shred its prey before eating them.

aggron.name: AGGRON
aggron.dex_entry: Aggron claims an entire mountain as its own territory. It mercilessly beats up anything that violates its environment. This Pokï¿½mon vigilantly patrols its territory at all times.

aipom.name: AIPOM
aipom.dex_entry: Aipom's tail ends in a hand-like appendage that can be cleverly manipulated. However, because the Pokï¿½mon uses its tail so much, its real hands have become rather clumsy.

alakazam.name: ALAKAZAM
alakazam.dex_entry: It has an incredibly high level of intelligence. Some say that Alakazam remembers everything that ever happens to it, from birth till death.

alcremie.name: ALCREMIE
alcremie.dex_entry: Cream pours endlessly from this Pokï¿½mon's body. The cream stiffens when compressed by an impact. A harder impact results in harder cream.

alomomola.name: ALOMOMOLA
alomomola.dex_entry: It uses its special mucus to close the wounds of injured Pokï¿½mon. The reason for this behavior remains unknown.

altaria.name: ALTARIA
altaria.dex_entry: Altaria dances and wheels through the sky among billowing, cotton-like clouds. By singing melodies in its crystal-clear voice, this Pokï¿½mon makes its listeners experience dreamy wonderment.

amaura.name: AMAURA
amaura.dex_entry: This ancient Pokï¿½mon was restored from part of its body that had been frozen in ice for over 100 million years.

ambipom.name: AMBIPOM
ambipom.dex_entry: They work in large colonies and make rings by linking their tails, apparently in friendship.

amoonguss.name: AMOONGUSS
amoonguss.dex_entry: This Pokï¿½mon puffs poisonous spores at its foes. If the spores aren't washed off quickly, they'll grow into mushrooms wherever they land.

ampharos.name: AMPHAROS
ampharos.dex_entry: Ampharos gives off so much light that it can be seen even from space. People in the old days used the light of this Pokï¿½mon to send signals back and forth with others far away.

anorith.name: ANORITH
anorith.dex_entry: Anorith was regenerated from a prehistoric fossil. This primitive Pokï¿½mon once lived in warm seas. It grips its prey firmly between its two large claws.

appletun.name: APPLETUN
appletun.dex_entry: Eating a sweet apple caused its evolution. A nectarous scent wafts from its body, luring in the bug Pokï¿½mon it preys on.

applin.name: APPLIN
applin.dex_entry: It spends its entire life inside an apple. It hides from its natural enemies, bird Pokï¿½mon, by pretending it's just an apple and nothing more.

araquanid.name: ARAQUANID
araquanid.dex_entry: It launches water bubbles with its legs, drowning prey within the bubbles. This Pokï¿½mon can then take its time to savor its meal.

arbok.name: ARBOK
arbok.dex_entry: This Pokï¿½mon is terrifically strong in order to constrict things with its body. It can even flatten steel oil drums. Once Arbok wraps its body around its foe, escaping its crunching embrace is impossible.

arcanine.name: ARCANINE
arcanine.dex_entry: The sight of it running over 6,200 miles in a single day and night has captivated many people.

arceus.name: ARCEUS
arceus.dex_entry: According to the legends of Sinnoh, this Pokï¿½mon emerged from an egg and shaped all there is in this world.

archen.name: ARCHEN
archen.dex_entry: It is the ancestor of all bird Pokï¿½mon. Archen itself could not actually fly but moved by hopping from treetop to treetop.

archeops.name: ARCHEOPS
archeops.dex_entry: Although apparently able to fly, they tended to run along the ground, averaging speeds of roughly 25 mph.

arctovish.name: ARCTOVISH
arctovish.dex_entry: Though it's able to capture prey by freezing its surroundings, it has trouble eating the prey afterward because its mouth is on top of its head.

arctozolt.name: ARCTOZOLT
arctozolt.dex_entry: The shaking of its freezing upper half is what generates its electricity. It has a hard time walking around.

ariados.name: ARIADOS
ariados.dex_entry: There are some areas where people use the string Ariados spins for their own weaving. The resulting cloth is popular for its strength.

armaldo.name: ARMALDO
armaldo.dex_entry: Armaldo's tough armor makes all attacks bounce off. This Pokï¿½mon's two enormous claws can be freely extended or contracted. They have the power to punch right through a steel slab.

aromatisse.name: AROMATISSE
aromatisse.dex_entry: The scent that constantly emits from its fur is so powerful that this Pokï¿½mon's companions will eventually lose their sense of smell.

aron.name: ARON
aron.dex_entry: This Pokï¿½mon has a body of steel. To make its body, Aron feeds on iron ore that it digs from mountains. Occasionally, it causes major trouble by eating bridges and rails.

arrokuda.name: ARROKUDA
arrokuda.dex_entry: If it sees any movement around it, this Pokï¿½mon charges for it straightaway, leading with its sharply pointed jaw. It's very proud of that jaw.

articuno.name: ARTICUNO
articuno.dex_entry: Articuno is a legendary bird Pokï¿½mon that can control ice. The flapping of its wings chills the air. As a result, it is said that when this Pokï¿½mon flies, snow will fall.

audino.name: AUDINO
audino.dex_entry: Using the feelers on its ears, it can tell how someone is feeling or when an egg might hatch.

aurorus.name: AURORUS
aurorus.dex_entry: The diamond-shaped crystals on its body expel air as cold as -240 degrees Fahrenheit, surrounding its enemies and encasing them in ice.

avalugg.name: AVALUGG
avalugg.dex_entry: At high latitudes, this Pokï¿½mon can be found with clusters of Bergmite on its back as it swims among the icebergs.

axew.name: AXEW
axew.dex_entry: These Pokï¿½mon nest in the ground and use their tusks to crush hard berries. Crushing berries is also how they test each other's strength.

azelf.name: AZELF
azelf.dex_entry: Known as ï¿½The Being of Willpower.ï¿½ It sleeps at the bottom of a lake to keep the world in balance.

azumarill.name: AZUMARILL
azumarill.dex_entry: It spends most of its time in the water. On sunny days, Azumarill floats on the surface of the water and sunbathes.

azurill.name: AZURILL
azurill.dex_entry: The ball on Azurill's tail bounces like a rubber ball, and it's full of the nutrients the Pokï¿½mon needs to grow.

bagon.name: BAGON
bagon.dex_entry: Its belief that it will be able to fly one day is apparently the influence of information carried in its genes.

baltoy.name: BALTOY
baltoy.dex_entry: It moves while spinning around on its single foot. Some Baltoy have been seen spinning on their heads.

banette.name: BANETTE
banette.dex_entry: Banette generates energy for laying strong curses by sticking pins into its own body. This Pokï¿½mon was originally a pitiful plush doll that was thrown away.

barbaracle.name: BARBARACLE
barbaracle.dex_entry: Seven Binacle come together to form one Barbaracle. The Binacle that serves as the head gives orders to those serving as the limbs.

barboach.name: BARBOACH
barboach.dex_entry: Its slimy body is hard to grasp. In one region, it is said to have been born from hardened mud.

barraskewda.name: BARRASKEWDA
barraskewda.dex_entry: This Pokï¿½mon has a jaw that's as sharp as a spear and as strong as steel. Apparently Barraskewda's flesh is surprisingly tasty, too.

basculin.name: BASCULIN
basculin.dex_entry: Anglers love the fight this Pokï¿½mon puts up on the hook. And there are always more to catchï¿½ many people release them into lakes illicitly.

bastiodon.name: BASTIODON
bastiodon.dex_entry: While it can guard against any sort of attack from the front, it is left without recourse when attacked from behind.

bayleef.name: BAYLEEF
bayleef.dex_entry: Bayleef's neck is ringed by curled-up leaves. Inside each tubular leaf is a small shoot of a tree. The fragrance of this shoot makes people peppy.

beartic.name: BEARTIC
beartic.dex_entry: It swims through frigid seas, searching for prey. From its frozen breath, it forms icy fangs that are harder than steel.

beautifly.name: BEAUTIFLY
beautifly.dex_entry: Beautifly's favorite food is the sweet pollen of flowers. If you want to see this Pokï¿½mon, just leave a potted flower by an open window. Beautifly is sure to come looking for pollen.

beedrill.name: BEEDRILL
beedrill.dex_entry: Beedrill is extremely territorial. No one should ever approach its nestï¿½this is for their own safety. If angered, they will attack in a furious swarm.

beheeyem.name: BEHEEYEM
beheeyem.dex_entry: Whenever a Beheeyem visits a farm, a Dubwool mysteriously disappears.

beldum.name: BELDUM
beldum.dex_entry: Its cells are all magnets. It uses magnetism to communicate with others of its kind.

bellossom.name: BELLOSSOM
bellossom.dex_entry: Plentiful in the tropics. When it dances, its petals rub together and make a pleasant ringing sound.

bellsprout.name: BELLSPROUT
bellsprout.dex_entry: Bellsprout's thin and flexible body lets it bend and sway to avoid any attack, however strong it may be. From its mouth, this Pokï¿½mon spits a corrosive fluid that melts even iron.

bergmite.name: BERGMITE
bergmite.dex_entry: They chill the air around them to -150 degrees Fahrenheit, freezing the water in the air into ice that they use as armor.

bewear.name: BEWEAR
bewear.dex_entry: Once it accepts you as a friend, it tries to show its affection with a hug. Letting it do that is dangerousï¿½it could easily shatter your bones.

bibarel.name: BIBAREL
bibarel.dex_entry: It busily makes its nest with stacks of branches and roots it has cut up with its sharp incisors.

bidoof.name: BIDOOF
bidoof.dex_entry: With nerves of steel, nothing can perturb it. It is more agile and active than it appears.

binacle.name: BINACLE
binacle.dex_entry: After two Binacle find a suitably sized rock, they adhere themselves to it and live together. They cooperate to gather food during high tide.

bisharp.name: BISHARP
bisharp.dex_entry: It's accompanied by a large retinue of Pawniard. Bisharp keeps a keen eye on its minions, ensuring none of them even think of double-crossing it.

blastoise.name: BLASTOISE
blastoise.dex_entry: It crushes its foe under its heavy body to cause fainting. In a pinch, it will withdraw inside its shell.

blaziken.name: BLAZIKEN
blaziken.dex_entry: In battle, Blaziken blows out intense flames from its wrists and attacks foes courageously. The stronger the foe, the more intensely this Pokï¿½mon's wrists burn.

blipbug.name: BLIPBUG
blipbug.dex_entry: A constant collector of information, this Pokï¿½mon is very smart. Very strong is what it isn't.

blissey.name: BLISSEY
blissey.dex_entry: Whenever a Blissey finds a weakened Pokï¿½mon, it will share its egg and offer its care until the other Pokï¿½mon is all better.

blitzle.name: BLITZLE
blitzle.dex_entry: When thunderclouds cover the sky, it will appear. It can catch lightning with its mane and store the electricity.

boldore.name: BOLDORE
boldore.dex_entry: If you see its orange crystals start to glow, be wary. It's about to fire off bursts of energy.

boltund.name: BOLTUND
boltund.dex_entry: This Pokï¿½mon generates electricity and channels it into its legs to keep them going strong. Boltund can run nonstop for three full days.

bonsly.name: BONSLY
bonsly.dex_entry: It expels both sweat and tears from its eyes. The sweat is a little salty, while the tears have a slight bitterness.

bouffalant.name: BOUFFALANT
bouffalant.dex_entry: These Pokï¿½mon can crush a car with no more than a headbutt. Bouffalant with more hair on their heads hold higher positions within the herd.

bounsweet.name: BOUNSWEET
bounsweet.dex_entry: Its body gives off a sweet, fruity scent that is extremely appetizing to bird Pokï¿½mon.

braixen.name: BRAIXEN
braixen.dex_entry: It has a twig stuck in its tail. With friction from its tail fur, it sets the twig on fire and launches into battle.

braviary.name: BRAVIARY
braviary.dex_entry: Known for its bravery and pride, this majestic Pokï¿½mon is often seen as a motif for various kinds of emblems.

breloom.name: BRELOOM
breloom.dex_entry: Breloom closes in on its foe with light and sprightly footwork, then throws punches with its stretchy arms. This Pokï¿½mon's fighting technique puts boxers to shame.

brionne.name: BRIONNE
brionne.dex_entry: As if dancing, it artfully dodges the attacks of its enemies. All the while, it's busy forming a bunch of balloons to overwhelm its foes.

bronzong.name: BRONZONG
bronzong.dex_entry: Some believe it to be a deity that summons rain clouds. When angered, it lets out a warning cry that rings out like the tolling of a bell.

bronzor.name: BRONZOR
bronzor.dex_entry: It appears in ancient ruins. The pattern on its body doesn't come from any culture in the Galar region, so it remains shrouded in mystery.

bruxish.name: BRUXISH
bruxish.dex_entry: When it unleashes its psychic power from the protuberance on its head, the grating sound of grinding teeth echoes through the area.

budew.name: BUDEW
budew.dex_entry: The pollen it releases contains poison. If this Pokï¿½mon is raised on clean water, the poison's toxicity is increased.

buizel.name: BUIZEL
buizel.dex_entry: It swims by rotating its two tails like a screw. When it dives, its flotation sac collapses.

bulbasaur.name: BULBASAUR
bulbasaur.dex_entry: There is a plant seed on its back right from the day this Pokï¿½mon is born. The seed slowly grows larger.

buneary.name: BUNEARY
buneary.dex_entry: If both of Buneary's ears are rolled up, something is wrong with its body or mind. It's a sure sign the Pokï¿½mon is in need of care.

bunnelby.name: BUNNELBY
bunnelby.dex_entry: It excels at digging holes. Using its ears, it can dig a nest 33 feet deep in one night.

burmy_plant.name: BURMY PLANT
burmy_plant.dex_entry: To shelter itself from cold, wintry winds, it covers itself with a cloak made of twigs and leaves.

burmy_sand.name: BURMY SAND
burmy_sand.dex_entry: To shelter itself from cold, wintry winds, it covers itself with a cloak made of twigs and leaves.

burmy_trash.name: BURMY TRASH
burmy_trash.dex_entry: To shelter itself from cold, wintry winds, it covers itself with a cloak made of twigs and leaves.

butterfree.name: BUTTERFREE
butterfree.dex_entry: Crystallized Gigantamax energy makes up this Pokï¿½mon's blindingly bright and highly toxic scales.

buzzwole.name: BUZZWOLE
buzzwole.dex_entry: This Ultra Beast appeared from another world. It shows off its body, but whether that display is a boast or a threat remains unclear.

cacnea.name: CACNEA
cacnea.dex_entry: Cacnea lives in arid locations such as deserts. It releases a strong aroma from its flower to attract prey. When prey comes near, this Pokï¿½mon shoots sharp thorns from its body to bring the victim down.

cacturne.name: CACTURNE
cacturne.dex_entry: During the daytime, Cacturne remains unmoving so that it does not lose any moisture to the harsh desert sun. This Pokï¿½mon becomes active at night when the temperature drops.

calyrex.name: CALYREX
calyrex.dex_entry: Calyrex is a merciful Pokï¿½mon, capable of providing healing and blessings. It reigned over the Galar region in times of yore.

camerupt.name: CAMERUPT
camerupt.dex_entry: Camerupt has a volcano inside its body. Magma of 18,000 degrees Fahrenheit courses through its body. Occasionally, the humps on this Pokï¿½mon's back erupt, spewing the superheated magma.

carbink.name: CARBINK
carbink.dex_entry: Born from the high temperatures and pressures deep underground, it defends itself by firing beams from the jewel part of its body.

carkol.name: CARKOL
carkol.dex_entry: It forms coal inside its body. Coal dropped by this Pokï¿½mon once helped fuel the lives of people in the Galar region.

carnivine.name: CARNIVINE
carnivine.dex_entry: It attracts prey with its sweet-smelling saliva, then chomps down. It takes a whole day to eat prey.

carracosta.name: CARRACOSTA
carracosta.dex_entry: It constructed its sturdy shell by crunching and swallowing the hard shells or bones of its prey.

carvanha.name: CARVANHA
carvanha.dex_entry: It won't attack while it's aloneï¿½not even if it spots prey. Instead, it waits for other Carvanha to join it, and then the Pokï¿½mon attack as a group.

cascoon.name: CASCOON
cascoon.dex_entry: Cascoon makes its protective cocoon by wrapping its body entirely with a fine silk from its mouth. Once the silk goes around its body, it hardens. This Pokï¿½mon prepares for its evolution inside the cocoon.

castform.name: CASTFORM
castform.dex_entry: It changes its form depending on the weather. Changes in the temperature or humidity appear to affect its cellular structure.

caterpie.name: CATERPIE
caterpie.dex_entry: For protection, it releases a horrible stench from the antenna on its head to drive away enemies.

celebi.name: CELEBI
celebi.dex_entry: This Pokï¿½mon has the ability to move through time. Records describing it as a forest deity can be found from many different eras.

celesteela.name: CELESTEELA
celesteela.dex_entry: It appeared from the Ultra Wormhole. Witnesses observed it flying across the sky at high speed.

centiskorch.name: CENTISKORCH
centiskorch.dex_entry: Gigantamax energy has evoked a rise in its body temperature, now reaching over 1,800 degrees Fahrenheit. Its heat waves incinerate its enemies.

chandelure.name: CHANDELURE
chandelure.dex_entry: This Pokï¿½mon haunts dilapidated mansions. It sways its arms to hypnotize opponents with the ominous dancing of its flames.

chansey.name: CHANSEY
chansey.dex_entry: The egg Chansey carries is not only delicious but also packed with nutrition. It's used as a high-class cooking ingredient.

charizard.name: CHARIZARD
charizard.dex_entry: It spits fire that is hot enough to melt boulders. It may cause forest fires by blowing flames.

charjabug.name: CHARJABUG
charjabug.dex_entry: While its durable shell protects it from attacks, Charjabug strikes at enemies with jolts of electricity discharged from the tips of its jaws.

charmander.name: CHARMANDER
charmander.dex_entry: It has a preference for hot things. When it rains, steam is said to spout from the tip of its tail.

charmeleon.name: CHARMELEON
charmeleon.dex_entry: It has a barbaric nature. In battle, it whips its fiery tail around and slashes away with sharp claws.

chatot.name: CHATOT
chatot.dex_entry: It mimics the cries of other Pokï¿½mon to trick them into thinking it's one of them. This way they won't attack it.

cherrim.name: CHERRIM
cherrim.dex_entry: After absorbing plenty of sunlight, Cherrim takes this form. It's full of energy while it's like this, and its liveliness will go on until sundown.

cherubi.name: CHERUBI
cherubi.dex_entry: It nimbly dashes about to avoid getting pecked by bird Pokï¿½mon that would love to make off with its small, nutrient-rich storage ball.

chesnaught.name: CHESNAUGHT
chesnaught.dex_entry: Its Tackle is forceful enough to flip a 50-ton tank. It shields its allies from danger with its own body.

chespin.name: CHESPIN
chespin.dex_entry: The quills on its head are usually soft. When it flexes them, the points become so hard and sharp that they can pierce rock.

chewtle.name: CHEWTLE
chewtle.dex_entry: Apparently the itch of its teething impels it to snap its jaws at anything in front of it.

chikorita.name: CHIKORITA
chikorita.dex_entry: In battle, Chikorita waves its leaf around to keep the foe at bay. However, a sweet fragrance also wafts from the leaf, becalming the battling Pokï¿½mon and creating a cozy, friendly atmosphere all around.

chimchar.name: CHIMCHAR
chimchar.dex_entry: Its fiery rear end is fueled by gas made in its belly. Even rain can't extinguish the fire.

chimecho.name: CHIMECHO
chimecho.dex_entry: Chimecho makes its cries echo inside its hollow body. When this Pokï¿½mon becomes enraged, its cries result in ultrasonic waves that have the power to knock foes flying.

chinchou.name: CHINCHOU
chinchou.dex_entry: Its antennae, which evolved from a fin, have both positive and negative charges flowing through them.

chingling.name: CHINGLING
chingling.dex_entry: Each time it hops, it makes a ringing sound. It deafens foes by emitting high-frequency cries.

cinccino.name: CINCCINO
cinccino.dex_entry: Its body secretes oil that this Pokï¿½mon spreads over its nest as a coating to protect it from dust. Cinccino won't tolerate even a speck of the stuff.

cinderace.name: CINDERACE
cinderace.dex_entry: Infused with Cinderace's fighting spirit, the gigantic Pyro Ball never misses its targets and completely roasts opponents.

clamperl.name: CLAMPERL
clamperl.dex_entry: Clamperl's sturdy shell is not only good for protectionï¿½it is also used for clamping and catching prey. A fully grown Clamperl's shell will be scored with nicks and scratches all over.

clauncher.name: CLAUNCHER
clauncher.dex_entry: Clauncher's claws can fall off during battle, but they'll regenerate. The meat inside the claws is popular as a delicacy in Galar.

clawitzer.name: CLAWITZER
clawitzer.dex_entry: After using the feelers on its oversized claw to detect the location of prey, Clawitzer launches a cannonball of water at its target.

claydol.name: CLAYDOL
claydol.dex_entry: This mysterious Pokï¿½mon started life as an ancient clay figurine made over 20,000 years ago.

clefable.name: CLEFABLE
clefable.dex_entry: A timid fairy Pokï¿½mon that is rarely seen, it will run and hide the moment it senses people.

clefairy.name: CLEFAIRY
clefairy.dex_entry: It is said that happiness will come to those who see a gathering of Clefairy dancing under a full moon.

cleffa.name: CLEFFA
cleffa.dex_entry: According to local rumors, Cleffa are often seen in places where shooting stars have fallen.

clobbopus.name: CLOBBOPUS
clobbopus.dex_entry: It's very curious, but its means of investigating things is to try to punch them with its tentacles. The search for food is what brings it onto land.

cloyster.name: CLOYSTER
cloyster.dex_entry: Its shell is extremely hard. It cannot be shattered, even with a bomb. The shell opens only when it is attacking.

coalossal.name: COALOSSAL
coalossal.dex_entry: Its body is a colossal stove. With Gigantamax energy stoking the fire, this Pokï¿½mon's flame burns hotter than 3,600 degrees Fahrenheit.

cobalion.name: COBALION
cobalion.dex_entry: It has a body and heart of steel. Its glare is sufficient to make even an unruly Pokï¿½mon obey it.

cofagrigus.name: COFAGRIGUS
cofagrigus.dex_entry: This Pokï¿½mon has a body of sparkling gold. People say it no longer remembers that it was once human.

combee.name: COMBEE
combee.dex_entry: The members of the trio spend all their time together. Each one has a slightly different taste in nectar.

combusken.name: COMBUSKEN
combusken.dex_entry: Combusken toughens up its legs and thighs by running through fields and mountains. This Pokï¿½mon's legs possess both speed and power, enabling it to dole out 10 kicks in one second.

comfey.name: COMFEY
comfey.dex_entry: Comfey picks flowers with its vine and decorates itself with them. For some reason, flowers won't wither once they're attached to a Comfey.

conkeldurr.name: CONKELDURR
conkeldurr.dex_entry: Concrete mixed by Conkeldurr is much more durable than normal concrete, even when the compositions of the two materials are the same.

copperajah.name: COPPERAJAH
copperajah.dex_entry: So much power is packed within its trunk that if it were to unleash that power, the resulting blast could level mountains and change the landscape.

corphish.name: CORPHISH
corphish.dex_entry: No matter how dirty the water in the river, it will adapt and thrive. It has a strong will to survive.

corsola.name: CORSOLA
corsola.dex_entry: It will regrow any branches that break off its head. People keep particularly beautiful Corsola branches as charms to promote safe childbirth.

corviknight.name: CORVIKNIGHT
corviknight.dex_entry: Imbued with Gigantamax energy, its wings can whip up winds more forceful than any a hurricane could muster. The gusts blow everything away.

corvisquire.name: CORVISQUIRE
corvisquire.dex_entry: Smart enough to use tools in battle, these Pokï¿½mon have been seen picking up rocks and flinging them or using ropes to wrap up enemies.

cosmoem.name: COSMOEM
cosmoem.dex_entry: The absorption of starlight fuels this Pokï¿½mon's growth. The shell that encases it is harder than any known material.

cosmog.name: COSMOG
cosmog.dex_entry: This Pokï¿½mon came from another universe. Its gaseous body is so light that even a gentle breeze can blow it away.

cottonee.name: COTTONEE
cottonee.dex_entry: It shoots cotton from its body to protect itself. If it gets caught up in hurricane-strength winds, it can get sent to the other side of the Earth.

crabominable.name: CRABOMINABLE
crabominable.dex_entry: It aimed for the top but got lost and ended up on a snowy mountain. Being forced to endure the cold, this Pokï¿½mon evolved and grew fur.

crabrawler.name: CRABRAWLER
crabrawler.dex_entry: While guarding its weak points with its pincers, it looks for an opening and unleashes punches. When it loses, it foams at the mouth and faints.

cradily.name: CRADILY
cradily.dex_entry: Cradily roams around the ocean floor in search of food. This Pokï¿½mon freely extends its tree trunk-like neck and captures unwary prey using its eight tentacles.

cramorant.name: CRAMORANT
cramorant.dex_entry: Cramorant's gluttony led it to try to swallow an Arrokuda whole, which in turn led to Cramorant getting an Arrokuda stuck in its throat.

cranidos.name: CRANIDOS
cranidos.dex_entry: It lived in jungles around a hundred million years ago. It used its skillful headbutts to combat Aerodactyl.

crawdaunt.name: CRAWDAUNT
crawdaunt.dex_entry: A rough customer that wildly flails its giant claws. It is said to be extremely hard to raise.

cresselia.name: CRESSELIA
cresselia.dex_entry: Shiny particles are released from its wings like a veil. It is said to represent the crescent moon.

croagunk.name: CROAGUNK
croagunk.dex_entry: It makes frightening noises with its poison-filled cheek sacs. When opponents flinch, Croagunk hits them with a poison jab.

crobat.name: CROBAT
crobat.dex_entry: Both its legs became wings, and as a result, it can't move well on the ground. All it can do is crawl around.

croconaw.name: CROCONAW
croconaw.dex_entry: Once Croconaw has clamped its jaws on its foe, it will absolutely not let go. Because the tips of its fangs are forked back like barbed fishhooks, they become impossible to remove when they have sunk in.

crustle.name: CRUSTLE
crustle.dex_entry: This highly territorial Pokï¿½mon prefers dry climates. It won't come out of its boulder on rainy days.

cryogonal.name: CRYOGONAL
cryogonal.dex_entry: They are born in snow clouds. They use chains made of ice crystals to capture prey.

cubchoo.name: CUBCHOO
cubchoo.dex_entry: When this Pokï¿½mon is in good health, its snot becomes thicker and stickier. It will smear its snot on anyone it doesn't like.

cubone.name: CUBONE
cubone.dex_entry: When the memory of its departed mother brings it to tears, its cries echo mournfully within the skull it wears on its head.

cufant.name: CUFANT
cufant.dex_entry: It digs up the ground with its trunk. It's also very strong, being able to carry loads of over five tons without any problem at all.

cursola.name: CURSOLA
cursola.dex_entry: Its shell is overflowing with its heightened otherworldly energy. The ectoplasm serves as protection for this Pokï¿½mon's core spirit.

cutiefly.name: CUTIEFLY
cutiefly.dex_entry: Nectar and pollen are its favorite fare. You can find Cutiefly hovering around Gossifleur, trying to get some of Gossifleur's pollen.

cyndaquil.name: CYNDAQUIL
cyndaquil.dex_entry: Cyndaquil protects itself by flaring up the flames on its back. The flames are vigorous if the Pokï¿½mon is angry. However, if it is tired, the flames splutter fitfully with incomplete combustion.

darkrai.name: DARKRAI
darkrai.dex_entry: It chases people and Pokï¿½mon from its territory by causing them to experience deep, nightmarish slumbers.

darmanitan.name: DARMANITAN
darmanitan.dex_entry: Anger has reignited its atrophied flame sac. This Pokï¿½mon spews fire everywhere as it rampages indiscriminately.

darmanitan_galarian.name: DARMANITAN GALARIAN
darmanitan_galarian.dex_entry: Anger has reignited its atrophied flame sac. This Pokï¿½mon spews fire everywhere as it rampages indiscriminately.

darmanitan_galarian_zenmode.name: DARMANITAN GALARIAN ZENMODE
darmanitan_galarian_zenmode.dex_entry: Anger has reignited its atrophied flame sac. This Pokï¿½mon spews fire everywhere as it rampages indiscriminately.

darmanitan_zenmode.name: DARMANITAN ZENMODE
darmanitan_zenmode.dex_entry: Anger has reignited its atrophied flame sac. This Pokï¿½mon spews fire everywhere as it rampages indiscriminately.

dartrix.name: DARTRIX
dartrix.dex_entry: It throws one knifelike feather after another at its enemies, and each one precisely strikes a weak point. These feathers are known as blade quills.

darumaka.name: DARUMAKA
darumaka.dex_entry: It derives its power from fire burning inside its body. If the fire dwindles, this Pokï¿½mon will immediately fall asleep.

darumaka_galarian.name: DARUMAKA GALARIAN
darumaka_galarian.dex_entry: It derives its power from fire burning inside its body. If the fire dwindles, this Pokï¿½mon will immediately fall asleep.

decidueye.name: DECIDUEYE
decidueye.dex_entry: As if wielding a bow, it launches the arrow quills hidden among the feathers of its wings. Decidueye's shots never miss.

decidueye_hisuian.name: DECIDUEYE HISUIAN
decidueye_hisuian.dex_entry: As if wielding a bow, it launches the arrow quills hidden among the feathers of its wings. Decidueye's shots never miss.

dedenne.name: DEDENNE
dedenne.dex_entry: A Dedenne's whiskers pick up electrical waves other Dedenne send out. These Pokï¿½mon share locations of food or electricity with one another.

deerling.name: DEERLING
deerling.dex_entry: Their coloring changes according to the seasons and can be slightly affected by the temperature and humidity as well.

deino.name: DEINO
deino.dex_entry: When it encounters something, its first urge is usually to bite it. If it likes what it tastes, it will commit the associated scent to memory.

delcatty.name: DELCATTY
delcatty.dex_entry: Delcatty prefers to live an unfettered existence in which it can do as it pleases at its own pace. Because this Pokï¿½mon eats and sleeps whenever it decides, its daily routines are completely random.

delibird.name: DELIBIRD
delibird.dex_entry: It carries food all day long. There are tales about lost people who were saved by the food it had.

delphox.name: DELPHOX
delphox.dex_entry: It gazes into the flame at the tip of its branch to achieve a focused state, which allows it to see into the future.

deoxys_attack.name: DEOXYS ATTACK
deoxys_attack.dex_entry: The DNA of a space virus underwent a sudden mutation upon exposure to a laser beam and resulted in Deoxys. The crystalline organ on this Pokï¿½mon's chest appears to be its brain.

deoxys_defense.name: DEOXYS DEFENSE
deoxys_defense.dex_entry: The DNA of a space virus underwent a sudden mutation upon exposure to a laser beam and resulted in Deoxys. The crystalline organ on this Pokï¿½mon's chest appears to be its brain.

deoxys_normal.name: DEOXYS NORMAL
deoxys_normal.dex_entry: The DNA of a space virus underwent a sudden mutation upon exposure to a laser beam and resulted in Deoxys. The crystalline organ on this Pokï¿½mon's chest appears to be its brain.

deoxys_speed.name: DEOXYS SPEED
deoxys_speed.dex_entry: The DNA of a space virus underwent a sudden mutation upon exposure to a laser beam and resulted in Deoxys. The crystalline organ on this Pokï¿½mon's chest appears to be its brain.

dewgong.name: DEWGONG
dewgong.dex_entry: Dewgong loves to snooze on bitterly cold ice. The sight of this Pokï¿½mon sleeping on a glacier was mistakenly thought to be a mermaid by a mariner long ago.

dewott.name: DEWOTT
dewott.dex_entry: Strict training is how it learns its flowing double-scalchop technique.

dewpider.name: DEWPIDER
dewpider.dex_entry: It forms a water bubble at the rear of its body and then covers its head with it. Meeting another Dewpider means comparing water-bubble sizes.

dhelmise.name: DHELMISE
dhelmise.dex_entry: After a piece of seaweed merged with debris from a sunken ship, it was reborn as this ghost Pokï¿½mon.

dialga.name: DIALGA
dialga.dex_entry: A Pokï¿½mon spoken of in legend. It is said that time began moving when Dialga was born.

diancie.name: DIANCIE
diancie.dex_entry: A sudden transformation of Carbink, its pink, glimmering body is said to be the loveliest sight in the whole world.

diggersby.name: DIGGERSBY
diggersby.dex_entry: With power equal to an excavator, it can dig through dense bedrock. It's a huge help during tunnel construction.

diglett.name: DIGLETT
diglett.dex_entry: If a Diglett digs through a field, it leaves the soil perfectly tilled and ideal for planting crops.

ditto.name: DITTO
ditto.dex_entry: It can reconstitute its entire cellular structure to change into what it sees, but it returns to normal when it relaxes.

dodrio.name: DODRIO
dodrio.dex_entry: Watch out if Dodrio's three heads are looking in three separate directions. It's a sure sign that it is on its guard. Don't go near this Pokï¿½mon if it's being waryï¿½it may decide to peck you.

doduo.name: DODUO
doduo.dex_entry: Doduo's two heads never sleep at the same time. Its two heads take turns sleeping, so one head can always keep watch for enemies while the other one sleeps.

donphan.name: DONPHAN
donphan.dex_entry: Donphan's favorite attack is curling its body into a ball, then charging at its foe while rolling at high speed. Once it starts rolling, this Pokï¿½mon can't stop very easily.

dottler.name: DOTTLER
dottler.dex_entry: It barely moves, but it's still alive. Hiding in its shell without food or water seems to have awakened its psychic powers.

doublade.name: DOUBLADE
doublade.dex_entry: Honedge evolves into twins. The two blades rub together to emit a metallic sound that unnerves opponents.

dracovish.name: DRACOVISH
dracovish.dex_entry: Powerful legs and jaws made it the apex predator of its time. Its own overhunting of its prey was what drove it to extinction.

dracozolt.name: DRACOZOLT
dracozolt.dex_entry: In ancient times, it was unbeatable thanks to its powerful lower body, but it went extinct anyway after it depleted all its plant-based food sources.

dragalge.name: DRAGALGE
dragalge.dex_entry: Dragalge uses a poisonous liquid capable of corroding metal to send tankers that enter its territory to the bottom of the sea.

dragapult.name: DRAGAPULT
dragapult.dex_entry: When it isn't battling, it keeps Dreepy in the holes on its horns. Once a fight starts, it launches the Dreepy like supersonic missiles.

dragonair.name: DRAGONAIR
dragonair.dex_entry: It has long been thought that its crystalline orbs are imbued with the power to control the weather.

dragonite.name: DRAGONITE
dragonite.dex_entry: This Pokï¿½mon saved a shipwrecked man, taking him to a remote islandï¿½a paradise occupied solely by Dragonite.

drakloak.name: DRAKLOAK
drakloak.dex_entry: It's capable of flying faster than 120 mph. It battles alongside Dreepy and dotes on them until they successfully evolve.

drampa.name: DRAMPA
drampa.dex_entry: The mountains it calls home are nearly two miles in height. On rare occasions, it descends to play with the children living in the towns below.

drapion.name: DRAPION
drapion.dex_entry: Its poison is potent, but it rarely sees use. This Pokï¿½mon prefers to use physical force instead, going on rampages with its car-crushing strength.

dratini.name: DRATINI
dratini.dex_entry: It grows by molting repeatedly. Boots made from the tanned cast-off skin are a super luxury item.

drednaw.name: DREDNAW
drednaw.dex_entry: It responded to Gigantamax energy by becoming bipedal. First it comes crashing down on foes, and then it finishes them off with its massive jaws.

dreepy.name: DREEPY
dreepy.dex_entry: After being reborn as a ghost Pokï¿½mon, Dreepy wanders the areas it used to inhabit back when it was alive in prehistoric seas.

drifblim.name: DRIFBLIM
drifblim.dex_entry: Some say this Pokï¿½mon is a collection of souls burdened with regrets, silently drifting through the dusk.

drifloon.name: DRIFLOON
drifloon.dex_entry: Perhaps seeking company, it approaches children. However, it often quickly runs away again when the children play too roughly with it.

drilbur.name: DRILBUR
drilbur.dex_entry: It brings its claws together and whirls around at high speed before rushing toward its prey.

drizzile.name: DRIZZILE
drizzile.dex_entry: A clever combatant, this Pokï¿½mon battles using water balloons created with moisture secreted from its palms.

drowzee.name: DROWZEE
drowzee.dex_entry: A Pokï¿½mon that nourishes itself by eating dreams, it is thought to share common ancestry with Munna and Musharna.

druddigon.name: DRUDDIGON
druddigon.dex_entry: Druddigon lives in caves, but it never skips sunbathingï¿½it won't be able to move if its body gets too cold.

dubwool.name: DUBWOOL
dubwool.dex_entry: Weave a carpet from its springy wool, and you end up with something closer to a trampoline. You'll start to bounce the moment you set foot on it.

ducklett.name: DUCKLETT
ducklett.dex_entry: When attacked, it uses its feathers to splash water, escaping under cover of the spray.

dugtrio.name: DUGTRIO
dugtrio.dex_entry: A team of Diglett triplets. It triggers huge earthquakes by burrowing 60 miles underground.

dunsparce.name: DUNSPARCE
dunsparce.dex_entry: This Pokï¿½mon's tiny wings have some scientists saying that Dunsparce used to fly through the sky in ancient times.

duosion.name: DUOSION
duosion.dex_entry: Its psychic power can supposedly cover a range of more than half a mileï¿½but only if its two brains can agree with each other.

duraludon.name: DURALUDON
duraludon.dex_entry: Its body resembles polished metal, and it's both lightweight and strong. The only drawback is that it rusts easily.

durant.name: DURANT
durant.dex_entry: They lay their eggs deep inside their nests. When attacked by Heatmor, they retaliate using their massive mandibles.

dusclops.name: DUSCLOPS
dusclops.dex_entry: Its body is entirely hollow. When it opens its mouth, it sucks everything in as if it were a black hole.

dusknoir.name: DUSKNOIR
dusknoir.dex_entry: At the bidding of transmissions from the spirit world, it steals people and Pokï¿½mon away. No one knows whether it has a will of its own.

duskull.name: DUSKULL
duskull.dex_entry: If it finds bad children who won't listen to their parents, it will spirit them awayï¿½or so it's said.

dustox.name: DUSTOX
dustox.dex_entry: Dustox is instinctively drawn to light. Swarms of this Pokï¿½mon are attracted by the bright lights of cities, where they wreak havoc by stripping the leaves off roadside trees for food.

dwebble.name: DWEBBLE
dwebble.dex_entry: When it finds a stone appealing, it creates a hole inside it and uses it as its home. This Pokï¿½mon is the natural enemy of Roggenrola and Rolycoly.

eelektrik.name: EELEKTRIK
eelektrik.dex_entry: It wraps itself around its prey and paralyzes it with electricity from the round spots on its sides. Then it chomps.

eelektross.name: EELEKTROSS
eelektross.dex_entry: With their sucker mouths, they suck in prey. Then they use their fangs to shock the prey with electricity.

eevee.name: EEVEE
eevee.dex_entry: Gigantamax energy upped the fluffiness of the fur around Eevee's neck. The fur will envelop a foe, capturing its body and captivating its mind.

eiscue.name: EISCUE
eiscue.dex_entry: It drifted in on the flow of ocean waters from a frigid place. It keeps its head iced constantly to make sure it stays nice and cold.

ekans.name: EKANS
ekans.dex_entry: Ekans curls itself up in a spiral while it rests. Assuming this position allows it to quickly respond to a threat from any direction with a glare from its upraised head.

eldegoss.name: ELDEGOSS
eldegoss.dex_entry: The seeds attached to its cotton fluff are full of nutrients. It spreads them on the wind so that plants and other Pokï¿½mon can benefit from them.

electabuzz.name: ELECTABUZZ
electabuzz.dex_entry: Half of all sudden blackouts are caused by Electabuzz gathering at electric power plants and gobbling up electricity.

electivire.name: ELECTIVIRE
electivire.dex_entry: It pushes the tips of its tails against its foes and then lets loose a high-voltage current. Its foes are burned to a crisp in an instant.

electrike.name: ELECTRIKE
electrike.dex_entry: It stores static electricity in its fur for discharging. It gives off sparks if a storm approaches.

electrode.name: ELECTRODE
electrode.dex_entry: Electrode eats electricity in the atmosphere. On days when lightning strikes, you can see this Pokï¿½mon exploding all over the place from eating too much electricity.

elekid.name: ELEKID
elekid.dex_entry: When it's in a house, electrical outlets serve as its baby bottles. It sucks down electricity.

elgyem.name: ELGYEM
elgyem.dex_entry: If this Pokï¿½mon stands near a TV, strange scenery will appear on the screen. That scenery is said to be from its home.

emboar.name: EMBOAR
emboar.dex_entry: It can throw a fire punch by setting its fists on fire with its fiery chin. It cares deeply about its friends.

emolga.name: EMOLGA
emolga.dex_entry: As Emolga flutters through the air, it crackles with electricity. This Pokï¿½mon is cute, but it can cause a lot of trouble.

empoleon.name: EMPOLEON
empoleon.dex_entry: It swims as fast as a jet boat. The edges of its wings are sharp and can slice apart drifting ice.

entei.name: ENTEI
entei.dex_entry: Entei embodies the passion of magma. This Pokï¿½mon is thought to have been born in the eruption of a volcano. It sends up massive bursts of fire that utterly consume all that they touch.

escavalier.name: ESCAVALIER
escavalier.dex_entry: They use shells they've stolen from Shelmet to arm and protect themselves. They're very popular Pokï¿½mon in the Galar region.

espeon.name: ESPEON
espeon.dex_entry: By reading air currents, it can predict things such as the weather or its foe's next move.

espurr.name: ESPURR
espurr.dex_entry: Though Espurr's expression never changes, behind that blank stare is an intense struggle to contain its devastating psychic power.

eternatus.name: ETERNATUS
eternatus.dex_entry: As a result of Rose's meddling, Eternatus absorbed all the energy in the Galar region. It's now in a state of power overload.

excadrill.name: EXCADRILL
excadrill.dex_entry: It's not uncommon for tunnels that appear to have formed naturally to actually be a result of Excadrill's rampant digging.

exeggcute.name: EXEGGCUTE
exeggcute.dex_entry: Though it may look like it's just a bunch of eggs, it's a proper Pokï¿½mon. Exeggcute communicates with others of its kind via telepathy, apparently.

exeggutor.name: EXEGGUTOR
exeggutor.dex_entry: Each of Exeggutor's three heads is thinking different thoughts. The three don't seem to be very interested in one another.

exeggutor_alolan.name: EXEGGUTOR ALOLAN
exeggutor_alolan.dex_entry: Each of Exeggutor's three heads is thinking different thoughts. The three don't seem to be very interested in one another.

exploud.name: EXPLOUD
exploud.dex_entry: In the past, people would use the loud voices of these Pokï¿½mon as a means of communication between distant cities.

falinks.name: FALINKS
falinks.dex_entry: Five of them are troopers, and one is the brass. The brass's orders are absolute.

farfetch_d.name: FARFETCH D
farfetch_d.dex_entry: The Farfetch'd of the Galar region are brave warriors, and they wield thick, tough leeks in battle.

farfetch_d_galarian.name: FARFETCH D GALARIAN
farfetch_d_galarian.dex_entry: The Farfetch'd of the Galar region are brave warriors, and they wield thick, tough leeks in battle.

fearow.name: FEAROW
fearow.dex_entry: It's tough and has excellent stamina. It has no problem flying continuously for a whole day carrying a heavy load.

feebas.name: FEEBAS
feebas.dex_entry: Although unattractive and unpopular, this Pokï¿½mon's marvelous vitality has made it a subject of research.

fennekin.name: FENNEKIN
fennekin.dex_entry: Eating a twig fills it with energy, and its roomy ears give vent to air hotter than 390 degrees Fahrenheit.

feraligatr.name: FERALIGATR
feraligatr.dex_entry: Feraligatr intimidates its foes by opening its huge mouth. In battle, it will kick the ground hard with its thick and powerful hind legs to charge at the foe at an incredible speed.

ferroseed.name: FERROSEED
ferroseed.dex_entry: It defends itself by launching spikes, but its aim isn't very good at first. Only after a lot of practice will it improve.

ferrothorn.name: FERROTHORN
ferrothorn.dex_entry: This Pokï¿½mon scrapes its spikes across rocks, and then uses the tips of its feelers to absorb the nutrients it finds within the stone.

finneon.name: FINNEON
finneon.dex_entry: It absorbs sunlight with the pink areas of its skin, which then shine. This appears to be a form of camouflage.

flaaffy.name: FLAAFFY
flaaffy.dex_entry: Flaaffy's wool quality changes so that it can generate a high amount of static electricity with a small amount of wool. The bare and slick parts of its hide are shielded against electricity.

flabebe_blue.name: FLABEBE BLUE
flabebe_blue.dex_entry: It draws out and controls the hidden power of flowers. The flower Flabï¿½bï¿½ holds is most likely part of its body.

flabebe_orange.name: FLABEBE ORANGE
flabebe_orange.dex_entry: It draws out and controls the hidden power of flowers. The flower Flabï¿½bï¿½ holds is most likely part of its body.

flabebe_red.name: FLABEBE RED
flabebe_red.dex_entry: It draws out and controls the hidden power of flowers. The flower Flabï¿½bï¿½ holds is most likely part of its body.

flabebe_white.name: FLABEBE WHITE
flabebe_white.dex_entry: It draws out and controls the hidden power of flowers. The flower Flabï¿½bï¿½ holds is most likely part of its body.

flabebe_yellow.name: FLABEBE YELLOW
flabebe_yellow.dex_entry: It draws out and controls the hidden power of flowers. The flower Flabï¿½bï¿½ holds is most likely part of its body.

flapple.name: FLAPPLE
flapple.dex_entry: It ate a sour apple, and that induced its evolution. In its cheeks, it stores an acid capable of causing chemical burns.

flareon.name: FLAREON
flareon.dex_entry: Once it has stored up enough heat, this Pokï¿½mon's body temperature can reach up to 1,700 degrees Fahrenheit.

fletchinder.name: FLETCHINDER
fletchinder.dex_entry: Fletchinder launches embers into the den of its prey. When the prey comes leaping out, Fletchinder's sharp talons finish it off.

fletchling.name: FLETCHLING
fletchling.dex_entry: Its melodious cries are actually warnings. Fletchling will mercilessly peck at anything that enters its territory.

floatzel.name: FLOATZEL
floatzel.dex_entry: It floats using its well-developed flotation sac. It assists in the rescues of drowning people.

floette_blue.name: FLOETTE BLUE
floette_blue.dex_entry: It flutters around fields of flowers and cares for flowers that are starting to wilt. It draws out the hidden power of flowers to battle.

floette_orange.name: FLOETTE ORANGE
floette_orange.dex_entry: It flutters around fields of flowers and cares for flowers that are starting to wilt. It draws out the hidden power of flowers to battle.

floette_red.name: FLOETTE RED
floette_red.dex_entry: It flutters around fields of flowers and cares for flowers that are starting to wilt. It draws out the hidden power of flowers to battle.

floette_white.name: FLOETTE WHITE
floette_white.dex_entry: It flutters around fields of flowers and cares for flowers that are starting to wilt. It draws out the hidden power of flowers to battle.

floette_yellow.name: FLOETTE YELLOW
floette_yellow.dex_entry: It flutters around fields of flowers and cares for flowers that are starting to wilt. It draws out the hidden power of flowers to battle.

florges_blue.name: FLORGES BLUE
florges_blue.dex_entry: It claims exquisite flower gardens as its territory, and it obtains power from basking in the energy emitted by flowering plants.

florges_orange.name: FLORGES ORANGE
florges_orange.dex_entry: It claims exquisite flower gardens as its territory, and it obtains power from basking in the energy emitted by flowering plants.

florges_red.name: FLORGES RED
florges_red.dex_entry: It claims exquisite flower gardens as its territory, and it obtains power from basking in the energy emitted by flowering plants.

florges_white.name: FLORGES WHITE
florges_white.dex_entry: It claims exquisite flower gardens as its territory, and it obtains power from basking in the energy emitted by flowering plants.

florges_yellow.name: FLORGES YELLOW
florges_yellow.dex_entry: It claims exquisite flower gardens as its territory, and it obtains power from basking in the energy emitted by flowering plants.

flygon.name: FLYGON
flygon.dex_entry: This Pokï¿½mon hides in the heart of sandstorms it creates and seldom appears where people can see it.

fomantis.name: FOMANTIS
fomantis.dex_entry: When bathed in sunlight, this Pokï¿½mon emits a pleasantly sweet scent, which causes bug Pokï¿½mon to gather around it.

foongus.name: FOONGUS
foongus.dex_entry: No one knows what the Pokï¿½ Ballï¿½like pattern on Foongus means or why Foongus has it.

forretress.name: FORRETRESS
forretress.dex_entry: Forretress conceals itself inside its hardened steel shell. The shell is opened when the Pokï¿½mon is catching prey, but it does so at such a quick pace that the shell's inside cannot be seen.

fraxure.name: FRAXURE
fraxure.dex_entry: After battle, this Pokï¿½mon carefully sharpens its tusks on river rocks. It needs to take care of its tusksï¿½if one breaks, it will never grow back.

frillish.name: FRILLISH
frillish.dex_entry: It envelops its prey in its veillike arms and draws it down to the deeps, five miles below the ocean's surface.

froakie.name: FROAKIE
froakie.dex_entry: It secretes flexible bubbles from its chest and back. The bubbles reduce the damage it would otherwise take when attacked.

frogadier.name: FROGADIER
frogadier.dex_entry: It can throw bubble-covered pebbles with precise control, hitting empty cans up to a hundred feet away.

froslass.name: FROSLASS
froslass.dex_entry: After a woman met her end on a snowy mountain, her regrets lingered on. From them, this Pokï¿½mon was born. Its favorite food is frozen souls.

frosmoth.name: FROSMOTH
frosmoth.dex_entry: Icy scales fall from its wings like snow as it flies over fields and mountains. The temperature of its wings is less than -290 degrees Fahrenheit.

furfrou.name: FURFROU
furfrou.dex_entry: Trimming its fluffy fur not only makes it more elegant but also increases the swiftness of its movements.

furret.name: FURRET
furret.dex_entry: Furret has a very slim build. When under attack, it can slickly squirm through narrow spaces and get away. In spite of its short limbs, this Pokï¿½mon is very nimble and fleet.

gabite.name: GABITE
gabite.dex_entry: In rare cases, it molts and sheds its scales. Medicine containing its scales as an ingredient will make a weary body feel invigorated.

gallade.name: GALLADE
gallade.dex_entry: True to its honorable-warrior image, it uses the blades on its elbows only in defense of something or someone.

galvantula.name: GALVANTULA
galvantula.dex_entry: It launches electrified fur from its abdomen as its means of attack. Opponents hit by the fur could be in for three full days and nights of paralysis.

garbodor.name: GARBODOR
garbodor.dex_entry: Due to Gigantamax energy, this Pokï¿½mon's toxic gas has become much thicker, congealing into masses shaped like discarded toys.

garchomp.name: GARCHOMP
garchomp.dex_entry: It can fly at speeds rivaling jet planes. It dives into flocks of bird Pokï¿½mon and gulps the entire flock down whole.

gardevoir.name: GARDEVOIR
gardevoir.dex_entry: It has the power to predict the future. Its power peaks when it is protecting its Trainer.

gastly.name: GASTLY
gastly.dex_entry: Born from gases, anyone would faint if engulfed by its gaseous body, which contains poison.

gastrodon.name: GASTRODON
gastrodon.dex_entry: It secretes a purple fluid to deter enemies. This fluid isn't poisonousï¿½instead, it's super sticky, and once it sticks, it's very hard to unstick.

genesect.name: GENESECT
genesect.dex_entry: This ancient bug Pokï¿½mon was altered by Team Plasma. They upgraded the cannon on its back.

gengar.name: GENGAR
gengar.dex_entry: On the night of a full moon, if shadows move on their own and laugh, it must be Gengar's doing.

geodude.name: GEODUDE
geodude.dex_entry: Its round body makes it easy to pick up, but it is hard and heavy. It's dangerous to play with them as if they were snowballs.

gible.name: GIBLE
gible.dex_entry: It lives in caves warmed by geothermal heat. Even so, when the weather gets cold, it will huddle close with others of its kind.

gigalith.name: GIGALITH
gigalith.dex_entry: This hardy Pokï¿½mon can often be found on construction sites and in mines, working alongside people and Copperajah.

girafarig.name: GIRAFARIG
girafarig.dex_entry: Girafarig's rear head also has a brain, but it is small. The rear head attacks in response to smells and sounds. Approaching this Pokï¿½mon from behind can cause the rear head to suddenly lash out and bite.

giratina.name: GIRATINA
giratina.dex_entry: This Pokï¿½mon is said to live in a world on the reverse side of ours, where common knowledge is distorted and strange.

glaceon.name: GLACEON
glaceon.dex_entry: Any who become captivated by the beauty of the snowfall that Glaceon creates will be frozen before they know it.

glalie.name: GLALIE
glalie.dex_entry: It has a body of ice that won't melt, even with fire. It can instantly freeze moisture in the atmosphere.

glameow.name: GLAMEOW
glameow.dex_entry: It claws if displeased and purrs when affectionate. Its fickleness is very popular among some.

glastrier.name: GLASTRIER
glastrier.dex_entry: Glastrier emits intense cold from its hooves. It's also a belligerent Pokï¿½monï¿½anything it wants, it takes by force.

gligar.name: GLIGAR
gligar.dex_entry: Gligar glides through the air without a sound as if it were sliding. This Pokï¿½mon hangs on to the face of its foe using its clawed hind legs and the large pincers on its forelegs, then injects the prey with its poison barb.

gliscor.name: GLISCOR
gliscor.dex_entry: It observes prey while hanging inverted from branches. When the chance presents itself, it swoops!

gloom.name: GLOOM
gloom.dex_entry: Its pistils exude an incredibly foul odor. The horrid stench can cause fainting at a distance of 1.25 miles.

gmrmime.name: GMRMIME
gmrmime.dex_entry: Its talent is tap-dancing. It can also manipulate temperatures to create a floor of ice, which this Pokï¿½mon can kick up to use as a barrier.

gogoat.name: GOGOAT
gogoat.dex_entry: It can tell how its Trainer is feeling by subtle shifts in the grip on its horns. This empathic sense lets them run as if one being.

golbat.name: GOLBAT
golbat.dex_entry: Its thick fangs are hollow like straws, making them unexpectedly fragile. These fangs are specialized for sucking blood.

goldeen.name: GOLDEEN
goldeen.dex_entry: Its dorsal, pectoral, and tail fins wave elegantly in water. That is why it is known as the Water Dancer.

golduck.name: GOLDUCK
golduck.dex_entry: This Pokï¿½mon lives in gently flowing rivers. It paddles through the water with its long limbs, putting its graceful swimming skills on display.

golem.name: GOLEM
golem.dex_entry: Its body can survive dynamite blasts without a single scratch, but it hates rain and humidity.

golett.name: GOLETT
golett.dex_entry: They were sculpted from clay in ancient times. No one knows why, but some of them are driven to continually line up boulders.

golisopod.name: GOLISOPOD
golisopod.dex_entry: It will do anything to win, taking advantage of every opening and finishing opponents off with the small claws on its front legs.

golurk.name: GOLURK
golurk.dex_entry: Artillery platforms built into the walls of ancient castles served as perches from which Golurk could fire energy beams.

goodra.name: GOODRA
goodra.dex_entry: Sometimes it misunderstands instructions and appears dazed or bewildered. Many Trainers don't mind, finding this behavior to be adorable.

goomy.name: GOOMY
goomy.dex_entry: Because most of its body is water, it will dry up if the weather becomes too arid. It's considered the weakest dragon Pokï¿½mon.

gorebyss.name: GOREBYSS
gorebyss.dex_entry: Gorebyss lives in the southern seas at extreme depths. Its body is built to withstand the enormous pressure of water at incredible depths. Because of this, this Pokï¿½mon's body is unharmed by ordinary attacks.

gossifleur.name: GOSSIFLEUR
gossifleur.dex_entry: It anchors itself in the ground with its single leg, then basks in the sun. After absorbing enough sunlight, its petals spread as it blooms brilliantly.

gothita.name: GOTHITA
gothita.dex_entry: Though they're still only babies, there's psychic power stored in their ribbonlike feelers, and sometimes they use that power to fight.

gothitelle.name: GOTHITELLE
gothitelle.dex_entry: It has tremendous psychic power, but it dislikes conflict. It's also able to predict the future based on the movement of the stars.

gothorita.name: GOTHORITA
gothorita.dex_entry: It's said that when stars shine in the night sky, this Pokï¿½mon will spirit away sleeping children. Some call it the Witch of Punishment.

gourgeist.name: GOURGEIST
gourgeist.dex_entry: Eerie cries emanate from its body in the dead of night. The sounds are said to be the wails of spirits who are suffering in the afterlife.

granbull.name: GRANBULL
granbull.dex_entry: Its well-developed lower jaw and heavy fangs are its weapons. As long as it's not provoked, it rarely bites.

grapploct.name: GRAPPLOCT
grapploct.dex_entry: A body made up of nothing but muscle makes the grappling moves this Pokï¿½mon performs with its tentacles tremendously powerful.

graveler.name: GRAVELER
graveler.dex_entry: Mossy rocks are its favorite food. It can devour a ton a day while crunching loudly.

greedent.name: GREEDENT
greedent.dex_entry: It stashes berries in its tailï¿½so many berries that they fall out constantly. But this Pokï¿½mon is a bit slow-witted, so it doesn't notice the loss.

greninja.name: GRENINJA
greninja.dex_entry: It creates throwing stars out of compressed water. When it spins them and throws them at high speed, these stars can split metal in two.

grimer.name: GRIMER
grimer.dex_entry: Its main source of food is the slimy industrial waste of factories. This Pokï¿½mon's numbers have been decreasing in recent years.

grimer_alolan.name: GRIMER ALOLAN
grimer_alolan.dex_entry: Its main source of food is the slimy industrial waste of factories. This Pokï¿½mon's numbers have been decreasing in recent years.

grimmsnarl.name: GRIMMSNARL
grimmsnarl.dex_entry: By transforming its leg hair, this Pokï¿½mon delivers power-packed drill kicks that can bore huge holes in Galar's terrain.

grookey.name: GROOKEY
grookey.dex_entry: When it uses its special stick to strike up a beat, the sound waves produced carry revitalizing energy to the plants and flowers in the area.

grotle.name: GROTLE
grotle.dex_entry: It lives along water in forests. In the daytime, it leaves the forest to sunbathe its treed shell.

groudon.name: GROUDON
groudon.dex_entry: Groudon is said to be the personification of the land itself. Legends tell of its many clashes against Kyogre, as each sought to gain the power of nature.

grovyle.name: GROVYLE
grovyle.dex_entry: The leaves growing out of Grovyle's body are convenient for camouflaging it from enemies in the forest. This Pokï¿½mon is a master at climbing trees in jungles.

growlithe.name: GROWLITHE
growlithe.dex_entry: It has a brave and trustworthy nature. It fearlessly stands up to bigger and stronger foes.

growlithe_hisuian.name: GROWLITHE HISUIAN
growlithe_hisuian.dex_entry: It has a brave and trustworthy nature. It fearlessly stands up to bigger and stronger foes.

grubbin.name: GRUBBIN
grubbin.dex_entry: Its natural enemies, like Rookidee, may flee rather than risk getting caught in its large mandibles that can snap thick tree branches.

grumpig.name: GRUMPIG
grumpig.dex_entry: Grumpig uses the black pearls on its body to amplify its psychic power waves for gaining total control over its foe. When this Pokï¿½mon uses its special power, its snorting breath grows labored.

gulpin.name: GULPIN
gulpin.dex_entry: Virtually all of Gulpin's body is its stomach. As a result, it can swallow something its own size. This Pokï¿½mon's stomach contains a special fluid that digests anything.

gumshoos.name: GUMSHOOS
gumshoos.dex_entry: When it finds a trace of its prey, it patiently stakes out the location...but it's always snoozing by nightfall.

gurdurr.name: GURDURR
gurdurr.dex_entry: It shows off its muscles to Machoke and other Gurdurr. If it fails to measure up to the other Pokï¿½mon, it lies low for a little while.

guzzlord.name: GUZZLORD
guzzlord.dex_entry: It has gobbled mountains and swallowed whole buildings, according to reports. It's one of the Ultra Beasts.

gyarados.name: GYARADOS
gyarados.dex_entry: It has an extremely aggressive nature. The Hyper Beam it shoots from its mouth totally incinerates all targets.

hakamo-o.name: HAKAMO-O
hakamo-o.dex_entry: The scaleless, scarred parts of its body are signs of its strength. It shows them off to defeated opponents.

happiny.name: HAPPINY
happiny.dex_entry: Mimicking Chansey, Happiny will place an egg- shaped stone in its belly pouch. Happiny will treasure this stone.

hariyama.name: HARIYAMA
hariyama.dex_entry: It is known for its fantastic strength, but as it grows older, it focuses more on training Makuhita.

hatenna.name: HATENNA
hatenna.dex_entry: Via the protrusion on its head, it senses other creatures' emotions. If you don't have a calm disposition, it will never warm up to you.

hatterene.name: HATTERENE
hatterene.dex_entry: It emits psychic power strong enough to cause headaches as a deterrent to the approach of others.

hattrem.name: HATTREM
hattrem.dex_entry: No matter who you are, if you bring strong emotions near this Pokï¿½mon, it will silence you violently.

haunter.name: HAUNTER
haunter.dex_entry: Its tongue is made of gas. If licked, its victim starts shaking constantly until death eventually comes.

hawlucha.name: HAWLUCHA
hawlucha.dex_entry: It drives its opponents to exhaustion with its agile maneuvers, then ends the fight with a flashy finishing move.

haxorus.name: HAXORUS
haxorus.dex_entry: Its resilient tusks are its pride and joy. It licks up dirt to take in the minerals it needs to keep its tusks in top condition.

heatmor.name: HEATMOR
heatmor.dex_entry: There's a hole in its tail that allows it to draw in the air it needs to keep its fire burning. If the hole gets blocked, this Pokï¿½mon will fall ill.

heatran.name: HEATRAN
heatran.dex_entry: It dwells in volcanic caves. It digs in with its cross-shaped feet to crawl on ceilings and walls.

heliolisk.name: HELIOLISK
heliolisk.dex_entry: A now-vanished desert culture treasured these Pokï¿½mon. Appropriately, when Heliolisk came to the Galar region, treasure came with them.

helioptile.name: HELIOPTILE
helioptile.dex_entry: When spread, the frills on its head act like solar panels, generating the power behind this Pokï¿½mon's electric moves.

heracross.name: HERACROSS
heracross.dex_entry: Heracross loves sweet sap and will go looking through forests for it. The Pokï¿½mon uses its two antennae to pick up scents as it searches.

herdier.name: HERDIER
herdier.dex_entry: Herdier is a very smart and friendly Pokï¿½mon. So much so that there's a theory that Herdier was the first Pokï¿½mon to partner with people.

hippopotas.name: HIPPOPOTAS
hippopotas.dex_entry: It moves through the sands with its mouth open, swallowing sand along with its prey. It gets rid of the sand by spouting it from its nose.

hippowdon.name: HIPPOWDON
hippowdon.dex_entry: Stones can get stuck in the ports on their bodies. Dwebble help dislodge such stones, so Hippowdon look after these Pokï¿½mon.

hitmonchan.name: HITMONCHAN
hitmonchan.dex_entry: Its punches slice the air. They are launched at such high speed, even a slight graze could cause a burn.

hitmonlee.name: HITMONLEE
hitmonlee.dex_entry: This amazing Pokï¿½mon has an awesome sense of balance. It can kick in succession from any position.

hitmontop.name: HITMONTOP
hitmontop.dex_entry: It launches kicks while spinning. If it spins at high speed, it may bore its way into the ground.

ho_oh.name: HO OH
ho_oh.dex_entry: Ho-Oh's feathers glow in seven colors depending on the angle at which they are struck by light. These feathers are said to bring happiness to the bearers. This Pokï¿½mon is said to live at the foot of a rainbow.

honchkrow.name: HONCHKROW
honchkrow.dex_entry: A single cry from this nocturnal Pokï¿½mon, and more than a hundred of its Murkrow cronies will assemble.

honedge.name: HONEDGE
honedge.dex_entry: Honedge's soul once belonged to a person who was killed a long time ago by the sword that makes up Honedge's body.

hoopa.name: HOOPA
hoopa.dex_entry: In its true form, it possess a huge amount of power. Legends of its avarice tell how it once carried off an entire castle to gain the treasure hidden within.

hoothoot.name: HOOTHOOT
hoothoot.dex_entry: It always stands on one foot. It changes feet so fast, the movement can rarely be seen.

hoppip.name: HOPPIP
hoppip.dex_entry: This Pokï¿½mon drifts and floats with the wind. If it senses the approach of strong winds, Hoppip links its leaves with other Hoppip to prepare against being blown away.

horsea.name: HORSEA
horsea.dex_entry: Horsea makes its home in oceans with gentle currents. If this Pokï¿½mon is under attack, it spits out pitch-black ink and escapes.

houndoom.name: HOUNDOOM
houndoom.dex_entry: In a Houndoom pack, the one with its horns raked sharply toward the back serves a leadership role. These Pokï¿½mon choose their leader by fighting among themselves.

houndour.name: HOUNDOUR
houndour.dex_entry: Houndour hunt as a coordinated pack. They communicate with each other using a variety of cries to corner their prey. This Pokï¿½mon's remarkable teamwork is unparalleled.

huntail.name: HUNTAIL
huntail.dex_entry: Huntail's presence went unnoticed by people for a long time because it lives at extreme depths in the sea. This Pokï¿½mon's eyes can see clearly even in the murky dark depths of the ocean.

hydreigon.name: HYDREIGON
hydreigon.dex_entry: There are a slew of stories about villages that were destroyed by Hydreigon. It bites anything that moves.

hypno.name: HYPNO
hypno.dex_entry: While it is an extremely dangerous Pokï¿½mon, people who are in need of a good, sound sleep call it their savior.

igglybuff.name: IGGLYBUFF
igglybuff.dex_entry: Igglybuff loves to sing. Its marshmallow-like body gives off a faint sweet smell.

illumise.name: ILLUMISE
illumise.dex_entry: Illumise attracts a swarm of Volbeat using a sweet fragrance. Once the Volbeat have gathered, this Pokï¿½mon leads the lit-up swarm in drawing geometric designs on the canvas of the night sky.

impidimp.name: IMPIDIMP
impidimp.dex_entry: Through its nose, it sucks in the emanations produced by people and Pokï¿½mon when they feel annoyed. It thrives off this negative energy.

incineroar.name: INCINEROAR
incineroar.dex_entry: It excels at violent, no-holds-barred battles. The temperature of the flames that issue from its navel exceeds 3,600 degrees Fahrenheit.

indeedee_female.name: INDEEDEE FEMALE
indeedee_female.dex_entry: It uses the horns on its head to sense the emotions of others. Males will act as valets for those they serve, looking after their every need.

indeedee_male.name: INDEEDEE MALE
indeedee_male.dex_entry: It uses the horns on its head to sense the emotions of others. Males will act as valets for those they serve, looking after their every need.

infernape.name: INFERNAPE
infernape.dex_entry: Its crown of fire is indicative of its fiery nature. It is beaten by none in terms of quickness.

inkay.name: INKAY
inkay.dex_entry: It spins while making its luminescent spots flash. These spots allow it to communicate with others by using different patterns of light.

inteleon.name: INTELEON
inteleon.dex_entry: Gigantamax Inteleon's Water Gun move fires at Mach 7. As the Pokï¿½mon takes aim, it uses the crest on its head to gauge wind and temperature.

ivysaur.name: IVYSAUR
ivysaur.dex_entry: When the bulb on its back grows large, it appears to lose the ability to stand on its hind legs.

jangmo-o.name: JANGMO-O
jangmo-o.dex_entry: They learn to fight by smashing their head scales together. The dueling strengthens both their skills and their spirits.

jellicent.name: JELLICENT
jellicent.dex_entry: Most of this Pokï¿½mon's body composition is identical to sea water. It makes sunken ships its lair.

jigglypuff.name: JIGGLYPUFF
jigglypuff.dex_entry: Jigglypuff has top-notch lung capacity, even by comparison to other Pokï¿½mon. It won't stop singing its lullabies until its foes fall asleep.

jirachi.name: JIRACHI
jirachi.dex_entry: Once every 1,000 years, the singing of a pure voice will rouse this Pokï¿½mon from its near- perpetual slumber. It wakes for only seven days.

jolteon.name: JOLTEON
jolteon.dex_entry: If it is angered or startled, the fur all over its body bristles like sharp needles that pierce foes.

joltik.name: JOLTIK
joltik.dex_entry: Joltik can be found clinging to other Pokï¿½mon. It's soaking up static electricity because it can't produce a charge on its own.

jumpluff.name: JUMPLUFF
jumpluff.dex_entry: Jumpluff rides warm southern winds to cross the sea and fly to foreign lands. The Pokï¿½mon descends to the ground when it encounters cold air while it is floating.

jynx.name: JYNX
jynx.dex_entry: Jynx walks rhythmically, swaying and shaking its hips as if it were dancing. Its motions are so bouncingly alluring, people seeing it are compelled to shake their hips without giving any thought to what they are doing.

kabuto.name: KABUTO
kabuto.dex_entry: Kabuto is a Pokï¿½mon that has been regenerated from a fossil. However, in extremely rare cases, living examples have been discovered. The Pokï¿½mon has not changed at all for 300 million years.

kabutops.name: KABUTOPS
kabutops.dex_entry: Kabutops swam underwater to hunt for its prey in ancient times. The Pokï¿½mon was apparently evolving from being a water dweller to living on land as evident from the beginnings of change in its gills and legs.

kadabra.name: KADABRA
kadabra.dex_entry: Using its psychic power, Kadabra levitates as it sleeps. It uses its springy tail as a pillow.

kakuna.name: KAKUNA
kakuna.dex_entry: Kakuna remains virtually immobile as it clings to a tree. However, on the inside, it is extremely busy as it prepares for its coming evolution. This is evident from how hot the shell becomes to the touch.

kangaskhan.name: KANGASKHAN
kangaskhan.dex_entry: Although it's carrying its baby in a pouch on its belly, Kangaskhan is swift on its feet. It intimidates its opponents with quick jabs.

karrablast.name: KARRABLAST
karrablast.dex_entry: Its strange physiology reacts to electrical energy in interesting ways. The presence of a Shelmet will cause this Pokï¿½mon to evolve.

kartana.name: KARTANA
kartana.dex_entry: This Ultra Beast came from the Ultra Wormhole. It seems not to attack enemies on its own, but its sharp body is a dangerous weapon in itself.

kecleon.name: KECLEON
kecleon.dex_entry: Kecleon is capable of changing its body colors at will to blend in with its surroundings. There is one exceptionï¿½this Pokï¿½mon can't change the zigzag pattern on its belly.

keldeo.name: KELDEO
keldeo.dex_entry: It crosses the world, running over the surfaces of oceans and rivers. It appears at scenic waterfronts.

kingdra.name: KINGDRA
kingdra.dex_entry: With the arrival of a storm at sea, this Pokï¿½mon will show itself on the surface. When a Kingdra and a Dragonite meet, a fierce battle ensues.

kingler.name: KINGLER
kingler.dex_entry: Its large and hard pincer has 10,000-horsepower strength. However, being so big, it is unwieldy to move.

kirlia.name: KIRLIA
kirlia.dex_entry: If its Trainer becomes happy, it overflows with energy, dancing joyously while spinning about.

klang.name: KLANG
klang.dex_entry: When Klang goes all out, the minigear links up perfectly with the outer part of the big gear, and this Pokï¿½mon's rotation speed increases sharply.

kleavor.name: KLEAVOR
kleavor.dex_entry: This Pokï¿½mon is constantly collecting keys. Entrust a Klefki with important keys, and the Pokï¿½mon will protect them no matter what.

klefki.name: KLEFKI
klefki.dex_entry: This Pokï¿½mon is constantly collecting keys. Entrust a Klefki with important keys, and the Pokï¿½mon will protect them no matter what.

klink.name: KLINK
klink.dex_entry: The two minigears that compose this Pokï¿½mon are closer than twins. They mesh well only with each other.

klinklang.name: KLINKLANG
klinklang.dex_entry: From its spikes, it launches powerful blasts of electricity. Its red core contains an enormous amount of energy.

koffing.name: KOFFING
koffing.dex_entry: Its body is full of poisonous gas. It floats into garbage dumps, seeking out the fumes of raw, rotting trash.

komala.name: KOMALA
komala.dex_entry: It is born asleep, and it dies asleep. All its movements are apparently no more than the results of it tossing and turning in its dreams.

kommo-o.name: KOMMO-O
kommo-o.dex_entry: It clatters its tail scales to unnerve opponents. This Pokï¿½mon will battle only those who stand steadfast in the face of this display.

krabby.name: KRABBY
krabby.dex_entry: It can be found near the sea. The large pincers grow back if they are torn out of their sockets.

kricketot.name: KRICKETOT
kricketot.dex_entry: It chats with others using the sounds of its colliding antennae. These sounds are fall hallmarks.

kricketune.name: KRICKETUNE
kricketune.dex_entry: It crosses its knifelike arms in front of its chest when it cries. It can compose melodies ad lib.

krokorok.name: KROKOROK
krokorok.dex_entry: Krokorok has specialized eyes that enable it to see in the dark. This ability lets Krokorok hunt in the dead of night without getting lost.

krookodile.name: KROOKODILE
krookodile.dex_entry: This Pokï¿½mon is known as the Bully of the Sands. Krookodile's mighty jaws can bite through heavy plates of iron with almost no effort at all.

kubfu.name: KUBFU
kubfu.dex_entry: Kubfu trains hard to perfect its moves. The moves it masters will determine which form it takes when it evolves.

kyogre.name: KYOGRE
kyogre.dex_entry: Through Primal Reversion and with nature's full power, it will take back its true form. It can summon storms that cause the sea levels to rise.

kyurem.name: KYUREM
kyurem.dex_entry: Dwelling within it is a power even greater than that of Reshiram or Zekrom, but the extreme cold keeps that power bound.

lairon.name: LAIRON
lairon.dex_entry: Lairon tempers its steel body by drinking highly nutritious mineral springwater until it is bloated. This Pokï¿½mon makes its nest close to springs of delicious water.

lampent.name: LAMPENT
lampent.dex_entry: This Pokï¿½mon appears just before someone passes away, so it's feared as an emissary of death.

landorus.name: LANDORUS
landorus.dex_entry: Lands visited by Landorus grant such bountiful crops that it has been hailed as ï¿½The Guardian of the Fields.ï¿½

lanturn.name: LANTURN
lanturn.dex_entry: The light it emits is so bright that it can illuminate the sea's surface from a depth of over three miles.

lapras.name: LAPRAS
lapras.dex_entry: A smart and kindhearted Pokï¿½mon, it glides across the surface of the sea while its beautiful song echoes around it.

larvesta.name: LARVESTA
larvesta.dex_entry: The people of ancient times believed that Larvesta fell from the sun.

larvitar.name: LARVITAR
larvitar.dex_entry: Born deep underground, it comes aboveground and becomes a pupa once it has finished eating the surrounding soil.

latias.name: LATIAS
latias.dex_entry: Latias is highly sensitive to the emotions of people. If it senses any hostility, this Pokï¿½mon ruffles the feathers all over its body and cries shrilly to intimidate the foe.

latios.name: LATIOS
latios.dex_entry: Latios has the ability to make others see an image of what it has seen or imagines in its head. This Pokï¿½mon is intelligent and understands human speech.

leafeon.name: LEAFEON
leafeon.dex_entry: Galarians favor the distinctive aroma that drifts from this Pokï¿½mon's leaves. There's a popular perfume made using that scent.

leavanny.name: LEAVANNY
leavanny.dex_entry: Upon finding a small Pokï¿½mon, it weaves clothing for it from leaves by using the sticky silk secreted from its mouth.

ledian.name: LEDIAN
ledian.dex_entry: While it's believed that starlight provides it with energy, this Pokï¿½mon also loves to eat berries. In the daytime, it curls up in the grass to sleep.

ledyba.name: LEDYBA
ledyba.dex_entry: They are timid and grow uneasy when not in a swarm with others of their kind. The pattern on their backs differs slightly from one to another.

lickilicky.name: LICKILICKY
lickilicky.dex_entry: Lickilicky's strange tongue can stretch to many times the length of its body. No one has figured out how Lickilicky's tongue can stretch so far.

lickitung.name: LICKITUNG
lickitung.dex_entry: If this Pokï¿½mon's sticky saliva gets on you and you don't clean it off, an intense itch will set in. The itch won't go away, either.

liepard.name: LIEPARD
liepard.dex_entry: Don't be fooled by its gorgeous fur and elegant figure. This is a moody and vicious Pokï¿½mon.

lileep.name: LILEEP
lileep.dex_entry: Lileep became extinct approximately a hundred million years ago. This ancient Pokï¿½mon attaches itself to a rock on the seafloor and catches approaching prey using tentacles shaped like flower petals.

lilligant.name: LILLIGANT
lilligant.dex_entry: It's believed that even first-rate gardeners have a hard time getting the flower on a Lilligant's head to bloom.

lillipup.name: LILLIPUP
lillipup.dex_entry: This Pokï¿½mon is courageous but also cautious. It uses the soft fur covering its face to collect information about its surroundings.

linoone.name: LINOONE
linoone.dex_entry: It uses its long tongue to taunt opponents. Once the opposition is enraged, this Pokï¿½mon hurls itself at the opponent, tackling them forcefully.

litleo.name: LITLEO
litleo.dex_entry: The stronger the opponent it faces, the more heat surges from its mane and the more power flows through its body.

litten.name: LITTEN
litten.dex_entry: It spends even the smallest amount of downtime grooming its fur with its tongue. Loose fur gathers in its stomach and serves as fuel for fiery moves.

litwick.name: LITWICK
