litwick.dex_entry: The flame on its head keeps its body slightly warm. This Pokï¿½mon takes lost children by the hand to guide them to the spirit world.

lombre.name: LOMBRE
lombre.dex_entry: It is nocturnal and becomes active at nightfall. It feeds on aquatic mosses that grow in the riverbed.

lopunny.name: LOPUNNY
lopunny.dex_entry: Lopunny is constantly monitoring its surroundings. If danger approaches, this Pokï¿½mon responds with superdestructive kicks.

lotad.name: LOTAD
lotad.dex_entry: It searches about for clean water. If it does not drink water for too long, the leaf on its head wilts.

loudred.name: LOUDRED
loudred.dex_entry: Loudred's ears serve as speakers, and they can put out sound waves powerful enough to blow away a house.

lucario.name: LUCARIO
lucario.dex_entry: It controls waves known as auras, which are powerful enough to pulverize huge rocks. It uses these waves to take down its prey.

ludicolo.name: LUDICOLO
ludicolo.dex_entry: The rhythm of bright, festive music activates Ludicolo's cells, making it more powerful.

lugia.name: LUGIA
lugia.dex_entry: Lugia's wings pack devastating powerï¿½a light fluttering of its wings can blow apart regular houses. As a result, this Pokï¿½mon chooses to live out of sight deep under the sea.

lumineon.name: LUMINEON
lumineon.dex_entry: With its shining light, it lures its prey close. However, the light also happens to attract ferocious fish Pokï¿½monï¿½its natural predators.

lunala.name: LUNALA
lunala.dex_entry: Known as the Beast That Calls the Moon, this Pokï¿½mon lives by taking in any and all light and converting it into its own energy.

lunatone.name: LUNATONE
lunatone.dex_entry: The phase of the moon apparently has some effect on its power. It's active on the night of a full moon.

lurantis.name: LURANTIS
lurantis.dex_entry: This Pokï¿½mon resembles a beautiful flower. A properly raised Lurantis will have gorgeous, brilliant colors.

luvdisc.name: LUVDISC
luvdisc.dex_entry: If a Luvdisc is left on its own, it becomes despondent, leaving itself open to attack. That is when Pelipper snatch them up.

luxio.name: LUXIO
luxio.dex_entry: By joining its tail with that of another Luxio, this Pokï¿½mon can receive some of the other Luxio's electricity and power up its own electric blasts.

luxray.name: LUXRAY
luxray.dex_entry: Luxray can see through solid objects. It will instantly spot prey trying to hide behind walls, even if the walls are thick.

lycanroc.name: LYCANROC
lycanroc.dex_entry: This Lycanroc is calm and cautious. The rocks jutting from its mane are razor sharp.

machamp.name: MACHAMP
machamp.dex_entry: It quickly swings its four arms to rock its opponents with ceaseless punches and chops from all angles.

machoke.name: MACHOKE
machoke.dex_entry: Its muscular body is so powerful, it must wear a power-save belt to be able to regulate its motions.

machop.name: MACHOP
machop.dex_entry: Its whole body is composed of muscles. Even though it's the size of a human child, it can hurl 100 grown-ups.

magby.name: MAGBY
magby.dex_entry: Many of these Pokï¿½mon can be seen in areas with volcanic activity. Feeding can get them so excited, they exhale flames of 1,100 degrees F.

magcargo.name: MAGCARGO
magcargo.dex_entry: Magcargo's shell is actually its skin that hardened as a result of cooling. Its shell is very brittle and fragileï¿½just touching it causes it to crumble apart. This Pokï¿½mon returns to its original size by dipping itself in magma.

magearna.name: MAGEARNA
magearna.dex_entry: This artificial Pokï¿½mon, constructed more than 500 years ago, can understand human speech but cannot itself speak.

magikarp.name: MAGIKARP
magikarp.dex_entry: It is virtually worthless in terms of both power and speed. It is the most weak and pathetic Pokï¿½mon in the world.

magmar.name: MAGMAR
magmar.dex_entry: When it's tired, it leaps into the mouth of a volcano and soaks its body in magma to ease its weariness. Its body burns at 2,192 degrees F.

magmortar.name: MAGMORTAR
magmortar.dex_entry: They dwell in volcanic craters. According to what is known, a single pair of male and female Magmortar lives in one volcano.

magnemite.name: MAGNEMITE
magnemite.dex_entry: At times, Magnemite runs out of electricity and ends up on the ground. If you give batteries to a grounded Magnemite, it'll start moving again.

magneton.name: MAGNETON
magneton.dex_entry: This Pokï¿½mon is three Magnemite that have linked together. Magneton sends out powerful radio waves to study its surroundings.

magnezone.name: MAGNEZONE
magnezone.dex_entry: Some say that Magnezone receives signals from space via the antenna on its head and that it's being controlled by some mysterious being.

makuhita.name: MAKUHITA
makuhita.dex_entry: It was originally brought in from another region, but now Makuhita from Alola are more famous.

malamar.name: MALAMAR
malamar.dex_entry: Gazing at its luminescent spots will quickly induce a hypnotic state, putting the observer under Malamar's control.

mamoswine.name: MAMOSWINE
mamoswine.dex_entry: This Pokï¿½mon can be spotted in wall paintings from as far back as 10,000 years ago. For a while, it was thought to have gone extinct.

manaphy.name: MANAPHY
manaphy.dex_entry: It is born with a wondrous power that lets it bond with any kind of Pokï¿½mon.

mandibuzz.name: MANDIBUZZ
mandibuzz.dex_entry: Although it's a bit of a ruffian, this Pokï¿½mon will take lost Vullaby under its wing and care for them till they're ready to leave the nest.

manectric.name: MANECTRIC
manectric.dex_entry: It stimulates its own muscles with electricity, so it can move quickly. It eases its soreness with electricity, too, so it can recover quickly as well.

mankey.name: MANKEY
mankey.dex_entry: It can spontaneously become enraged. Everyone near it clears out as it rampages, and the resulting loneliness makes it angrier still.

mantine.name: MANTINE
mantine.dex_entry: If it builds up enough speed swimming, it can jump out above the waves and glide for over 300 feet.

mantyke.name: MANTYKE
mantyke.dex_entry: Mantyke living in Galar seem to be somewhat sluggish. The colder waters of the seas in this region may be the cause.

maractus.name: MARACTUS
maractus.dex_entry: With noises that could be mistaken for the rattles of maracas, it creates an upbeat rhythm, startling bird Pokï¿½mon and making them fly off in a hurry.

mareanie.name: MAREANIE
mareanie.dex_entry: The first symptom of its sting is numbness. The next is an itching sensation so intense that it's impossible to resist the urge to claw at your skin.

mareep.name: MAREEP
mareep.dex_entry: Mareep's fluffy coat of wool rubs together and builds a static charge. The more static electricity is charged, the more brightly the lightbulb at the tip of its tail glows.

marill.name: MARILL
marill.dex_entry: This Pokï¿½mon uses its round tail as a float. The ball of Marill's tail is filled with nutrients that have been turned into an oil.

marowak.name: MAROWAK
marowak.dex_entry: This Pokï¿½mon overcame its sorrow to evolve a sturdy new body. Marowak faces its opponents bravely, using a bone as a weapon.

marowak_alolan.name: MAROWAK ALOLAN
marowak_alolan.dex_entry: This Pokï¿½mon overcame its sorrow to evolve a sturdy new body. Marowak faces its opponents bravely, using a bone as a weapon.

marshadow.name: MARSHADOW
marshadow.dex_entry: By slipping into the shadow of a martial arts master and copying their movements, this Pokï¿½mon learned the ultimate techniques.

marshtomp.name: MARSHTOMP
marshtomp.dex_entry: The surface of Marshtomp's body is enveloped by a thin, sticky film that enables it to live on land. This Pokï¿½mon plays in mud on beaches when the ocean tide is low.

masquerain.name: MASQUERAIN
masquerain.dex_entry: It intimidates enemies with the eye-like patterns on its antennae. Its four wings allow it to fly in any direction.

mawile.name: MAWILE
mawile.dex_entry: It uses its docile-looking face to lull foes into complacency, then bites with its huge, relentless jaws.

medicham.name: MEDICHAM
medicham.dex_entry: It is said that through meditation, Medicham heightens energy inside its body and sharpens its sixth sense. This Pokï¿½mon hides its presence by merging itself with fields and mountains.

meditite.name: MEDITITE
meditite.dex_entry: Meditite undertakes rigorous mental training deep in the mountains. However, whenever it meditates, this Pokï¿½mon always loses its concentration and focus. As a result, its training never ends.

meganium.name: MEGANIUM
meganium.dex_entry: The fragrance of Meganium's flower soothes and calms emotions. In battle, this Pokï¿½mon gives off more of its becalming scent to blunt the foe's fighting spirit.

melmetal.name: MELMETAL
melmetal.dex_entry: At the end of its life-span, Melmetal will rust and fall apart. The small shards left behind will eventually be reborn as Meltan.

meloetta.name: MELOETTA
meloetta.dex_entry: The melodies sung by Meloetta have the power to make Pokï¿½mon that hear them happy or sad.

meltan.name: MELTAN
meltan.dex_entry: It dissolves and eats metal. Circulating liquid metal within its body is how it generates energy.

meowstic_female.name: MEOWSTIC FEMALE
meowstic_female.dex_entry: Females are a bit more selfish and aggressive than males. If they don't get what they want, they will torment you with their psychic abilities.

meowstic_male.name: MEOWSTIC MALE
meowstic_male.dex_entry: Females are a bit more selfish and aggressive than males. If they don't get what they want, they will torment you with their psychic abilities.

meowth.name: MEOWTH
meowth.dex_entry: It loves to collect shiny things. If it's in a good mood, it might even let its Trainer have a look at its hoard of treasures.

mesprit.name: MESPRIT
mesprit.dex_entry: Known as ï¿½The Being of Emotion.ï¿½ It taught humans the nobility of sorrow, pain, and joy.

metagross.name: METAGROSS
metagross.dex_entry: It firmly pins its prey using its four claws and large body. Then the teeth in the mouth on its stomach chew the prey to bits.

metang.name: METANG
metang.dex_entry: When two Beldum link together, their psychic power is doubled. Their intelligence, however, remains unchanged.

metapod.name: METAPOD
metapod.dex_entry: It is waiting for the moment to evolve. At this stage, it can only harden, so it remains motionless to avoid attack.

mew.name: MEW
mew.dex_entry: Mew is said to possess the genetic composition of all Pokï¿½mon. It is capable of making itself invisible at will, so it entirely avoids notice even if it approaches people.

mewtwo.name: MEWTWO
mewtwo.dex_entry: Mewtwo is a Pokï¿½mon that was created by genetic manipulation. However, even though the scientific power of humans created this Pokï¿½mon's body, they failed to endow Mewtwo with a compassionate heart.

mienfoo.name: MIENFOO
mienfoo.dex_entry: In one minute, a well-trained Mienfoo can chop with its arms more than 100 times.

mienshao.name: MIENSHAO
mienshao.dex_entry: When Mienshao comes across a truly challenging opponent, it will lighten itself by biting off the fur on its arms.

mightyena.name: MIGHTYENA
mightyena.dex_entry: Mightyena gives obvious signals when it is preparing to attack. It starts to growl deeply and then flattens its body. This Pokï¿½mon will bite savagely with its sharply pointed fangs.

milcery.name: MILCERY
milcery.dex_entry: This Pokï¿½mon was born from sweet-smelling particles in the air. Its body is made of cream.

milotic.name: MILOTIC
milotic.dex_entry: Milotic has provided inspiration to many artists. It has even been referred to as the most beautiful Pokï¿½mon of all.

miltank.name: MILTANK
miltank.dex_entry: Miltank produces highly nutritious milk, so it's been supporting the lives of people and other Pokï¿½mon since ancient times.

mime_jr.name: MIME JR
mime_jr.dex_entry: It mimics everyone it sees, but it puts extra effort into copying the graceful dance steps of Mr. Rime as practice.

mimikyu.name: MIMIKYU
mimikyu.dex_entry: It wears a rag fashioned into a Pikachu costume in an effort to look less scary. Unfortunately, the costume only makes it creepier.

minccino.name: MINCCINO
minccino.dex_entry: The way it brushes away grime with its tail can be helpful when cleaning. But its focus on spotlessness can make cleaning more of a hassle.

minior.name: MINIOR
minior.dex_entry: Originally making its home in the ozone layer, it hurtles to the ground when the shell enclosing its body grows too heavy.

minun.name: MINUN
minun.dex_entry: Minun is more concerned about cheering on its partners than its own safety. It shorts out the electricity in its body to create brilliant showers of sparks to cheer on its teammates.

misdreavus.name: MISDREAVUS
misdreavus.dex_entry: It will use any means necessary to frighten people and absorb their life energy. It practices constantly to hone its skill in causing fear.

mismagius.name: MISMAGIUS
mismagius.dex_entry: It appears as if from nowhereï¿½muttering incantations, placing curses, and giving people terrifying visions.

moltres.name: MOLTRES
moltres.dex_entry: Moltres is a legendary bird Pokï¿½mon that has the ability to control fire. If this Pokï¿½mon is injured, it is said to dip its body in the molten magma of a volcano to burn and heal itself.

monferno.name: MONFERNO
monferno.dex_entry: It skillfully controls the intensity of the fire on its tail to keep its foes at an ideal distance.

morelull.name: MORELULL
morelull.dex_entry: Pokï¿½mon living in the forest eat the delicious caps on Morelull's head. The caps regrow overnight.

morgrem.name: MORGREM
morgrem.dex_entry: When it gets down on all fours as if to beg for forgiveness, it's trying to lure opponents in so that it can stab them with its spear-like hair.

morpeko.name: MORPEKO
morpeko.dex_entry: As it eats the seeds stored up in its pocket-like pouches, this Pokï¿½mon is not just satisfying its constant hunger. It's also generating electricity.

mothim.name: MOTHIM
mothim.dex_entry: It loves the honey of flowers and steals honey collected by Combee.

mrmime.name: MRMIME
mrmime.dex_entry: The broadness of its hands may be no coincidence-many scientists believe its palms became enlarged specifically for pantomiming.

mrmime_galarian.name: MRMIME GALARIAN
mrmime_galarian.dex_entry: Its talent is tap-dancing. It can also manipulate temperatures to create a floor of ice, which this Pokï¿½mon can kick up to use as a barrier.

mrrime.name: MRRIME
mrrime.dex_entry: It's highly skilled at tap-dancing. It waves its cane of ice in time with its graceful movements.

mudbray.name: MUDBRAY
mudbray.dex_entry: Loads weighing up to 50 times as much as its own body weight pose no issue for this Pokï¿½mon. It's skilled at making use of mud.

mudkip.name: MUDKIP
mudkip.dex_entry: The fin on Mudkip's head acts as highly sensitive radar. Using this fin to sense movements of water and air, this Pokï¿½mon can determine what is taking place around it without using its eyes.

mudsdale.name: MUDSDALE
mudsdale.dex_entry: Mud that hardens around a Mudsdale's legs sets harder than stone. It's so hard that it allows this Pokï¿½mon to scrap a truck with a single kick.

muk.name: MUK
muk.dex_entry: The stench it gives off will make your nose scrunch up. Still, there are Muk fans who think that's a good thing.

muk_alolan.name: MUK ALOLAN
muk_alolan.dex_entry: The stench it gives off will make your nose scrunch up. Still, there are Muk fans who think that's a good thing.

munchlax.name: MUNCHLAX
munchlax.dex_entry: Stuffing itself with vast amounts of food is its only concern. Whether the food is rotten or fresh, yummy or tastelessï¿½it does not care.

munna.name: MUNNA
munna.dex_entry: Late at night, it appears beside people's pillows. As it feeds on dreams, the patterns on its body give off a faint glow.

murkrow.name: MURKROW
murkrow.dex_entry: They awaken at dusk and take wing in the twilight, leading to the expression, ï¿½Get home before the Murkrow fly.ï¿½

musharna.name: MUSHARNA
musharna.dex_entry: When dark mists emanate from its body, don't get too near. If you do, your nightmares will become reality.

natu.name: NATU
natu.dex_entry: It is extremely good at climbing tree trunks and likes to eat the new sprouts on the trees.

necrozma.name: NECROZMA
necrozma.dex_entry: It survives by absorbing light. After a long time spent slumbering underground, impurities accumulated within it, causing its body to darken.

nickit.name: NICKIT
nickit.dex_entry: Aided by the soft pads on its feet, it silently raids the food stores of other Pokï¿½mon. It survives off its ill-gotten gains.

nidoking.name: NIDOKING
nidoking.dex_entry: Nidoking's thick tail packs enormously destructive power. With one swing, it can topple a metal transmission tower. Once this Pokï¿½mon goes on a rampage, there is no stopping it.

nidoqueen.name: NIDOQUEEN
nidoqueen.dex_entry: Nidoqueen's body is encased in extremely hard scales. It is adept at sending foes flying with harsh tackles. This Pokï¿½mon is at its strongest when it is defending its young.

nidoran_f.name: NIDORAN F
nidoran_f.dex_entry: Nidoran has barbs that secrete a powerful poison. They are thought to have developed as protection for this small-bodied Pokï¿½mon. When enraged, it releases a horrible toxin from its horn.

nidoran_m.name: NIDORAN M
nidoran_m.dex_entry: Nidoran has developed muscles for moving its ears. Thanks to them, the ears can be freely moved in any direction. Even the slightest sound does not escape this Pokï¿½mon's notice.

nidorina.name: NIDORINA
nidorina.dex_entry: When Nidorina are with their friends or family, they keep their barbs tucked away to prevent hurting each other. This Pokï¿½mon appears to become nervous if separated from the others.

nidorino.name: NIDORINO
nidorino.dex_entry: Nidorino has a horn that is harder than a diamond. If it senses a hostile presence, all the barbs on its back bristle up at once, and it challenges the foe with all its might.

nihilego.name: NIHILEGO
nihilego.dex_entry: One of several mysterious Ultra Beasts. People on the street report observing those infested by it suddenly becoming violent.

nincada.name: NINCADA
nincada.dex_entry: Because it lived almost entirely underground, it is nearly blind. It uses its antennae instead.

ninetales.name: NINETALES
ninetales.dex_entry: It is said to live 1,000 years, and each of its tails is loaded with supernatural powers.

ninjask.name: NINJASK
ninjask.dex_entry: Its cry leaves a lasting headache if heard for too long. It moves so quickly that it is almost invisible.

noctowl.name: NOCTOWL
noctowl.dex_entry: Its eyes are specially developed to enable it to see clearly even in murky darkness and minimal light.

noibat.name: NOIBAT
noibat.dex_entry: After nightfall, they emerge from the caves they nest in during the day. Using their ultrasonic waves, they go on the hunt for ripened fruit.

noivern.name: NOIVERN
noivern.dex_entry: Aggressive and cruel, this Pokï¿½mon will ruthlessly torment enemies that are helpless in the dark.

nosepass.name: NOSEPASS
nosepass.dex_entry: The magnet in Nosepass's nose provides an unerring compass, making it an excellent partner for Trainers going on a journey.

numel.name: NUMEL
numel.dex_entry: Numel is extremely dull wittedï¿½it doesn't notice being hit. However, it can't stand hunger for even a second. This Pokï¿½mon's body is a seething cauldron of boiling magma.

nuzleaf.name: NUZLEAF
nuzleaf.dex_entry: It lives deep in forests. With the leaf on its head, it makes a flute whose song makes listeners uneasy.

obstagoon.name: OBSTAGOON
obstagoon.dex_entry: Its voice is staggering in volume. Obstagoon has a tendency to take on a threatening posture and shoutï¿½this move is known as Obstruct.

octillery.name: OCTILLERY
octillery.dex_entry: It has a tendency to want to be in holes. It prefers rock crags or pots and sprays ink from them before attacking.

oddish.name: ODDISH
oddish.dex_entry: If exposed to moonlight, it starts to move. It roams far and wide at night to scatter its seeds.

omanyte.name: OMANYTE
omanyte.dex_entry: Omanyte is one of the ancient and long-since-extinct Pokï¿½mon that have been regenerated from fossils by people. If attacked by an enemy, it withdraws itself inside its hard shell.

omastar.name: OMASTAR
omastar.dex_entry: Omastar uses its tentacles to capture its prey. It is believed to have become extinct because its shell grew too large and heavy, causing its movements to become too slow and ponderous.

onix.name: ONIX
onix.dex_entry: As it digs through the ground, it absorbs many hard objects. This is what makes its body so solid.

oranguru.name: ORANGURU
oranguru.dex_entry: With waves of its fanï¿½made from leaves and its own furï¿½Oranguru skillfully gives instructions to other Pokï¿½mon.

orbeetle.name: ORBEETLE
orbeetle.dex_entry: Its brain has grown to a gargantuan size, as has the rest of its body. This Pokï¿½mon's intellect and psychic abilities are overpowering.

oricorio.name: ORICORIO
oricorio.dex_entry: It beats its wings together to create fire. As it moves in the steps of its beautiful dance, it bathes opponents in intense flames.

oshawott.name: OSHAWOTT
oshawott.dex_entry: The scalchop on its stomach isn't just used for battleï¿½it can be used to break open hard berries as well.

pachirisu.name: PACHIRISU
pachirisu.dex_entry: It makes fur balls that crackle with static electricity. It stores them with berries in tree holes.

palkia.name: PALKIA
palkia.dex_entry: It is said to live in a gap in the spatial dimension parallel to ours. It appears in mythology.

palossand.name: PALOSSAND
palossand.dex_entry: Palossand is known as the Beach Nightmare. It pulls its prey down into the sand by controlling the sand itself, and then it sucks out their souls.

palpitoad.name: PALPITOAD
palpitoad.dex_entry: It weakens its prey with sound waves intense enough to cause headaches, then entangles them with its sticky tongue.

pancham.name: PANCHAM
pancham.dex_entry: It chooses a Pangoro as its master and then imitates its master's actions. This is how it learns to battle and hunt for prey.

pangoro.name: PANGORO
pangoro.dex_entry: This Pokï¿½mon is quick to anger, and it has no problem using its prodigious strength to get its way. It lives for duels against Obstagoon.

panpour.name: PANPOUR
panpour.dex_entry: The water stored inside the tuft on its head is full of nutrients. It waters plants with it using its tail.

pansage.name: PANSAGE
pansage.dex_entry: It shares the leaf on its head with weary-looking Pokï¿½mon. These leaves are known to relieve stress.

pansear.name: PANSEAR
pansear.dex_entry: Very intelligent, it roasts berries before eating them. It likes to help people.

paras.name: PARAS
paras.dex_entry: No matter how much it eats, the mushrooms growing on its back steal away most of the nutrients it consumes.

parasect.name: PARASECT
parasect.dex_entry: The large mushroom on its back controls it. It often fights over territory with Shiinotic.

passimian.name: PASSIMIAN
passimian.dex_entry: Displaying amazing teamwork, they follow the orders of their boss as they all help out in the search for their favorite berries.

patrat.name: PATRAT
patrat.dex_entry: Using food stored in cheek pouches, they can keep watch for days. They use their tails to communicate with others.

pawniard.name: PAWNIARD
pawniard.dex_entry: It uses river stones to maintain the cutting edges of the blades covering its body. These sharpened blades allow it to bring down opponents.

pelipper.name: PELIPPER
pelipper.dex_entry: It is a messenger of the skies, carrying small Pokï¿½mon and eggs to safety in its bill.

perrserker.name: PERRSERKER
perrserker.dex_entry: What appears to be an iron helmet is actually hardened hair. This Pokï¿½mon lives for the thrill of battle.

persian.name: PERSIAN
persian.dex_entry: Getting this prideful Pokï¿½mon to warm up to you takes a lot of effort, and it will claw at you the moment it gets annoyed.

petilil.name: PETILIL
petilil.dex_entry: Petilil appears around sources of clean water. Boiling leaves from this Pokï¿½mon's head results in a liquid that's sometimes used as a bug repellent.

phanpy.name: PHANPY
phanpy.dex_entry: For its nest, Phanpy digs a vertical pit in the ground at the edge of a river. It marks the area around its nest with its trunk to let the others know that the area has been claimed.

phantump.name: PHANTUMP
phantump.dex_entry: After a lost child perished in the forest, their spirit possessed a tree stump, causing the spirit's rebirth as this Pokï¿½mon.

pheromosa.name: PHEROMOSA
pheromosa.dex_entry: One of the dangerous Ultra Beasts, it has been spotted running across the land at terrific speeds.

phione.name: PHIONE
phione.dex_entry: When the water warms, they inflate the flotation sac on their heads and drift languidly on the sea in packs.

pichu.name: PICHU
pichu.dex_entry: Despite its small size, it can zap even adult humans. However, if it does so, it also surprises itself.

pidgeot.name: PIDGEOT
pidgeot.dex_entry: This Pokï¿½mon has a dazzling plumage of beautifully glossy feathers. Many Trainers are captivated by the striking beauty of the feathers on its head, compelling them to choose Pidgeot as their Pokï¿½mon.

pidgeotto.name: PIDGEOTTO
pidgeotto.dex_entry: Pidgeotto claims a large area as its own territory. This Pokï¿½mon flies around, patrolling its living space. If its territory is violated, it shows no mercy in thoroughly punishing the foe with its sharp claws.

pidgey.name: PIDGEY
pidgey.dex_entry: Pidgey has an extremely sharp sense of direction. It is capable of unerringly returning home to its nest, however far it may be removed from its familiar surroundings.

pidove.name: PIDOVE
pidove.dex_entry: Where people go, these Pokï¿½mon follow. If you're scattering food for them, be carefulï¿½ several hundred of them can gather at once.

pignite.name: PIGNITE
pignite.dex_entry: The more it eats, the more fuel it has to make the fire in its stomach stronger. This fills it with even more power.

pikachu.name: PIKACHU
pikachu.dex_entry: Its Gigantamax power expanded, forming its supersized body and towering tail.

pikipek.name: PIKIPEK
pikipek.dex_entry: It can peck at a rate of 16 times a second to drill holes in trees. It uses the holes for food storage and for nesting.

piloswine.name: PILOSWINE
piloswine.dex_entry: If it charges at an enemy, the hairs on its back stand up straight. It is very sensitive to sound.

pincurchin.name: PINCURCHIN
pincurchin.dex_entry: It feeds on seaweed, using its teeth to scrape it off rocks. Electric current flows from the tips of its spines.

pineco.name: PINECO
pineco.dex_entry: Pineco hangs from a tree branch and patiently waits for prey to come along. If the Pokï¿½mon is disturbed while eating by someone shaking its tree, it drops down to the ground and explodes with no warning.

pinsir.name: PINSIR
pinsir.dex_entry: These Pokï¿½mon judge one another based on pincers. Thicker, more impressive pincers make for more popularity with the opposite gender.

piplup.name: PIPLUP
piplup.dex_entry: It doesn't like to be taken care of. It's difficult to bond with since it won't listen to its Trainer.

plusle.name: PLUSLE
plusle.dex_entry: Plusle always acts as a cheerleader for its partners. Whenever a teammate puts out a good effort in battle, this Pokï¿½mon shorts out its body to create the crackling noises of sparks to show its joy.

politoed.name: POLITOED
politoed.dex_entry: At nightfall, these Pokï¿½mon appear on the shores of lakes. They announce their territorial claims by letting out cries that sound like shouting.

poliwag.name: POLIWAG
poliwag.dex_entry: For Poliwag, swimming is easier than walking. The swirl pattern on its belly is actually part of the Pokï¿½mon's innards showing through the skin.

poliwhirl.name: POLIWHIRL
poliwhirl.dex_entry: Staring at the swirl on its belly causes drowsiness. This trait of Poliwhirl's has been used in place of lullabies to get children to go to sleep.

poliwrath.name: POLIWRATH
poliwrath.dex_entry: Its body is solid muscle. When swimming through cold seas, Poliwrath uses its impressive arms to smash through drift ice and plow forward.

polteageist.name: POLTEAGEIST
polteageist.dex_entry: This species lives in antique teapots. Most pots are forgeries, but on rare occasions, an authentic work is found.

ponyta.name: PONYTA
ponyta.dex_entry: It can't run properly when it's newly born. As it races around with others of its kind, its legs grow stronger.

poochyena.name: POOCHYENA
poochyena.dex_entry: At first sight, Poochyena takes a bite at anything that moves. This Pokï¿½mon chases after prey until the victim becomes exhausted. However, it may turn tail if the prey strikes back.

popplio.name: POPPLIO
popplio.dex_entry: It creates special bouncy balloons to send at its opponents. When the balloons pop, the sheer force of their bursting is what deals damage.

porygon.name: PORYGON
porygon.dex_entry: State-of-the-art technology was used to create Porygon. It was the first artificial Pokï¿½mon to be created via computer programming.

porygon2.name: PORYGON2
porygon2.dex_entry: This is a Porygon that was updated with special data. Porygon2 develops itself by learning about many different subjects all on its own.

porygonz.name: PORYGONZ
porygonz.dex_entry: Porygon-Z had a program installed to allow it to move between dimensions, but the program also caused instability in Porygon-Z's behavior.

primarina.name: PRIMARINA
primarina.dex_entry: With its mouth, it makes sonic waves that sound like beautiful singing. It uses the sonic waves to control its water balloons.

primeape.name: PRIMEAPE
primeape.dex_entry: It has been known to become so angry that it dies as a result. Its face looks peaceful in death, however.

prinplup.name: PRINPLUP
prinplup.dex_entry: It lives alone, away from others. Apparently, every one of them believes it is the most important.

probopass.name: PROBOPASS
probopass.dex_entry: It radiates such a powerful magnetic field that nearby electrical appliances become unusable.

psyduck.name: PSYDUCK
psyduck.dex_entry: Psyduck is constantly beset by headaches. If the Pokï¿½mon lets its strange power erupt, apparently the pain subsides for a while.

pumpkaboo.name: PUMPKABOO
pumpkaboo.dex_entry: Spirits that wander this world are placed into Pumpkaboo's body. They're then moved on to the afterlife.

pupitar.name: PUPITAR
pupitar.dex_entry: Even sealed in its shell, it can move freely. Hard and fast, it has outstanding destructive power.

purrloin.name: PURRLOIN
purrloin.dex_entry: It steals things from people just to amuse itself with their frustration. A rivalry exists between this Pokï¿½mon and Nickit.

purugly.name: PURUGLY
purugly.dex_entry: It would claim another Pokï¿½mon's nest as its own if it finds a nest sufficiently comfortable.

pyroar.name: PYROAR
pyroar.dex_entry: The male with the largest mane of fire is the leader of the pride.

pyukumuku.name: PYUKUMUKU
pyukumuku.dex_entry: It lives in warm, shallow waters. If it encounters a foe, it will spit out its internal organs as a means to punch them.

quagsire.name: QUAGSIRE
quagsire.dex_entry: It has an easygoing nature. It doesn't care if it bumps its head on boats and boulders while swimming.

quilava.name: QUILAVA
quilava.dex_entry: Quilava keeps its foes at bay with the intensity of its flames and gusts of superheated air. This Pokï¿½mon applies its outstanding nimbleness to dodge attacks even while scorching the foe with flames.

quilladin.name: QUILLADIN
quilladin.dex_entry: It relies on its sturdy shell to deflect predators' attacks. It counterattacks with its sharp quills.

qwilfish.name: QWILFISH
qwilfish.dex_entry: When faced with a larger opponent, it swallows as much water as it can to match the opponent's size.

raboot.name: RABOOT
raboot.dex_entry: Its thick and fluffy fur protects it from the cold and enables it to use hotter fire moves.

raichu.name: RAICHU
raichu.dex_entry: Its long tail serves as a ground to protect itself from its own high-voltage power.

raichu_alolan.name: RAICHU ALOLAN
raichu_alolan.dex_entry: Its long tail serves as a ground to protect itself from its own high-voltage power.

raikou.name: RAIKOU
raikou.dex_entry: Raikou embodies the speed of lightning. The roars of this Pokï¿½mon send shock waves shuddering through the air and shake the ground as if lightning bolts had come crashing down.

ralts.name: RALTS
ralts.dex_entry: It is highly attuned to the emotions of people and Pokï¿½mon. It hides if it senses hostility.

rampardos.name: RAMPARDOS
rampardos.dex_entry: The result of repeated headbutts is a skull grown thick and hard. However, its brain has shrunk in size compared with Cranidos's.

rapidash.name: RAPIDASH
rapidash.dex_entry: Little can stand up to its psycho cut. Unleashed from this Pokï¿½mon's horn, the move will punch a hole right through a thick metal sheet.

raticate.name: RATICATE
raticate.dex_entry: Its hind feet are webbed, so it's a strong swimmer. It can cross rivers and sometimes even oceans.

rattata.name: RATTATA
rattata.dex_entry: Its incisors continue growing until its death. If its Trainer doesn't offer it a file to gnaw on, it will gnaw on door frames, table legs, and so on.

rayquaza.name: RAYQUAZA
rayquaza.dex_entry: Rayquaza is said to have lived for hundreds of millions of years. Legends remain of how it put to rest the clash between Kyogre and Groudon.

regice.name: REGICE
regice.dex_entry: Regice's body was made during an ice age. The deep-frozen body can't be melted, even by fire. This Pokï¿½mon controls frigid air of -328 degrees Fahrenheit.

regidrago.name: REGIDRAGO
regidrago.dex_entry: An academic theory proposes that Regidrago's arms were once the head of an ancient dragon Pokï¿½mon. The theory remains unproven.

regieleki.name: REGIELEKI
regieleki.dex_entry: This Pokï¿½mon is a cluster of electrical energy. It's said that removing the rings on Regieleki's body will unleash the Pokï¿½mon's latent power.

regigigas.name: REGIGIGAS
regigigas.dex_entry: It is said to have made Pokï¿½mon that look like itself from a special ice mountain, rocks, and magma.

regirock.name: REGIROCK
regirock.dex_entry: Regirock was sealed away by people long ago. If this Pokï¿½mon's body is damaged in battle, it is said to seek out suitable rocks on its own to repair itself.

registeel.name: REGISTEEL
registeel.dex_entry: Registeel has a body that is harder than any kind of metal. Its body is apparently hollow. No one has any idea what this Pokï¿½mon eats.

relicanth.name: RELICANTH
relicanth.dex_entry: Its form has remained the same for one hundred million years. Its body is filled with fat, so it can withstand the water pressure of the deep sea.

remoraid.name: REMORAID
remoraid.dex_entry: The water they shoot from their mouths can hit moving prey from more than 300 feet away.

reshiram.name: RESHIRAM
reshiram.dex_entry: Flames spew from its tail as it flies through the sky like a jet airplane. It's said that this Pokï¿½mon will scorch the world.

reuniclus.name: REUNICLUS
reuniclus.dex_entry: While it could use its psychic abilities in battle, this Pokï¿½mon prefers to swing its powerful arms around to beat opponents into submission.

rhydon.name: RHYDON
rhydon.dex_entry: It begins walking on its hind legs after evolution. It can punch holes through boulders with its horn.

rhyhorn.name: RHYHORN
rhyhorn.dex_entry: Strong, but not too bright, this Pokï¿½mon can shatter even a skyscraper with its charging tackles.

rhyperior.name: RHYPERIOR
rhyperior.dex_entry: It can load up to three projectiles per arm into the holes in its hands. What launches out of those holes could be either rocks or Roggenrola.

ribombee.name: RIBOMBEE
ribombee.dex_entry: It makes pollen puffs from pollen and nectar. The puffs' effects depend on the type of ingredients and how much of each one is used.

rillaboom.name: RILLABOOM
rillaboom.dex_entry: By drumming, it taps into the power of its special tree stump. The roots of the stump follow its direction in battle.

riolu.name: RIOLU
riolu.dex_entry: It's exceedingly energetic, with enough stamina to keep running all through the night. Taking it for walks can be a challenging experience.

rockruff.name: ROCKRUFF
rockruff.dex_entry: This Pokï¿½mon can bond very strongly with its Trainer, but it also has a habit of biting. Raising a Rockruff for a long time can be challenging.

roggenrola.name: ROGGENROLA
roggenrola.dex_entry: It's as hard as steel, but apparently a long soak in water will cause it to soften a bit.

rolycoly.name: ROLYCOLY
rolycoly.dex_entry: Most of its body has the same composition as coal. Fittingly, this Pokï¿½mon was first discovered in coal mines about 400 years ago.

rookidee.name: ROOKIDEE
rookidee.dex_entry: It will bravely challenge any opponent, no matter how powerful. This Pokï¿½mon benefits from every battleï¿½even a defeat increases its strength a bit.

roselia.name: ROSELIA
roselia.dex_entry: Its flowers give off a relaxing fragrance. The stronger its aroma, the healthier the Roselia is.

roserade.name: ROSERADE
roserade.dex_entry: After captivating opponents with its sweet scent, it lashes them with its thorny whips.

rotom.name: ROTOM
rotom.dex_entry: One boy's invention led to the development of many different machines that take advantage of Rotom's unique capabilities.

rotom_fan.name: ROTOM FAN
rotom_fan.dex_entry: In this form, Rotom applies its new power over wind to its love of pranks. It will happily blow away any important documents it can find.

rotom_frost.name: ROTOM FROST
rotom_frost.dex_entry: Rotom assumes this form when it takes over a refrigerator powered by a special motor. It battles by spewing cold air.

rotom_heat.name: ROTOM HEAT
rotom_heat.dex_entry: This Rotom has possessed a convection microwave oven that uses a special motor. It also has a flair for manipulating flames.

rotom_mow.name: ROTOM MOW
rotom_mow.dex_entry: This is Rotom after it's seized control of a lawn mower that has a special motor. As it mows down grass, it scatters the clippings everywhere.

rotom_wash.name: ROTOM WASH
rotom_wash.dex_entry: This form of Rotom enjoys coming up with water- based pranks. Be careful with it if you don't want your room flooded.

rowlet.name: ROWLET
rowlet.dex_entry: At a distance, it launches its sharp feathers while flying about. If the enemy gets too close, Rowlet switches tactics and delivers vicious kicks.

rufflet.name: RUFFLET
rufflet.dex_entry: If it spies a strong Pokï¿½mon, Rufflet can't resist challenging it to a battle. But if Rufflet loses, it starts bawling.

runerigus.name: RUNERIGUS
runerigus.dex_entry: A powerful curse was woven into an ancient painting. After absorbing the spirit of a Yamask, the painting began to move.

sableye.name: SABLEYE
sableye.dex_entry: This Pokï¿½mon is feared. When its gemstone eyes begin to glow with a sinister shine, it's believed that Sableye will steal people's spirits away.

salamence.name: SALAMENCE
salamence.dex_entry: When angered, it loses all sense of itself and destroys everything around it. The destruction will continue until Salamence has tired itself out.

salandit.name: SALANDIT
salandit.dex_entry: Its venom sacs produce a fluid that this Pokï¿½mon then heats up with the flame in its tail. This process creates Salandit's poisonous gas.

salazzle.name: SALAZZLE
salazzle.dex_entry: Only female Salazzle exist. They emit a gas laden with pheromones to captivate male Salandit.

samurott.name: SAMUROTT
samurott.dex_entry: In the time it takes a foe to blink, it can draw and sheathe the seamitars attached to its front legs.

samurott_hisuian.name: SAMUROTT HISUIAN
samurott_hisuian.dex_entry: In the time it takes a foe to blink, it can draw and sheathe the seamitars attached to its front legs.

sandaconda.name: SANDACONDA
sandaconda.dex_entry: Its sand pouch has grown to tremendous proportions. More than 1,000,000 tons of sand now swirl around its body.

sandile.name: SANDILE
sandile.dex_entry: The desert gets cold at night, so when the sun sets, this Pokï¿½mon burrows deep into the sand and sleeps until sunrise.

sandshrew.name: SANDSHREW
sandshrew.dex_entry: It loves to bathe in the grit of dry, sandy areas. By sand bathing, the Pokï¿½mon rids itself of dirt and moisture clinging to its body.

sandslash.name: SANDSLASH
sandslash.dex_entry: It uses large, hooked claws to cut a path through deep snow as it runs. On snowy mountains, this Sandslash is faster than any other Pokï¿½mon.

sandygast.name: SANDYGAST
sandygast.dex_entry: Grudges of the dead have possessed a mound of sand and become a Pokï¿½mon. Sandygast is fond of the shovel on its head.

sawk.name: SAWK
sawk.dex_entry: If you see a Sawk training in the mountains in its single-minded pursuit of strength, it's best to quietly pass by.

sawsbuck.name: SAWSBUCK
sawsbuck.dex_entry: They migrate according to the seasons. People can tell the season by looking at Sawsbuck's horns.

scatterbug.name: SCATTERBUG
scatterbug.dex_entry: When under attack from bird Pokï¿½mon, it spews a poisonous black powder that causes paralysis on contact.

sceptile.name: SCEPTILE
sceptile.dex_entry: The leaves growing on Sceptile's body are very sharp edged. This Pokï¿½mon is very agileï¿½it leaps all over the branches of trees and jumps on its foe from above or behind.

scizor.name: SCIZOR
scizor.dex_entry: Bulky pincers account for one third of Scizor's body weight. A single swing of one of these pincers will crush a boulder completely.

scolipede.name: SCOLIPEDE
scolipede.dex_entry: Scolipede latches on to its prey with the claws on its neck before slamming them into the ground and jabbing them with its claws' toxic spikes.

scorbunny.name: SCORBUNNY
scorbunny.dex_entry: A warm-up of running around gets fire energy coursing through this Pokï¿½mon's body. Once that happens, it's ready to fight at full power.

scrafty.name: SCRAFTY
scrafty.dex_entry: As halfhearted as this Pokï¿½mon's kicks may seem, they pack enough power to shatter Conkeldurr's concrete pillars.

scraggy.name: SCRAGGY
scraggy.dex_entry: If it locks eyes with you, watch out! Nothing and no one is safe from the reckless headbutts of this troublesome Pokï¿½mon.

scyther.name: SCYTHER
scyther.dex_entry: As Scyther fights more and more battles, its scythes become sharper and sharper. With a single slice, Scyther can fell a massive tree.

seadra.name: SEADRA
seadra.dex_entry: It's the males that raise the offspring. While Seadra are raising young, the spines on their backs secrete thicker and stronger poison.

seaking.name: SEAKING
seaking.dex_entry: In autumn, its body becomes more fatty in preparing to propose to a mate. It takes on beautiful colors.

sealeo.name: SEALEO
sealeo.dex_entry: Sealeo has the habit of always juggling on the tip of its nose anything it sees for the first time. This Pokï¿½mon occasionally entertains itself by balancing and rolling a Spheal on its nose.

seedot.name: SEEDOT
seedot.dex_entry: If it remains still, it looks just like a real nut. It delights in surprising foraging Pokï¿½mon.

seel.name: SEEL
seel.dex_entry: Seel hunts for prey in the frigid sea underneath sheets of ice. When it needs to breathe, it punches a hole through the ice with the sharply protruding section of its head.

seismitoad.name: SEISMITOAD
seismitoad.dex_entry: The vibrating of the bumps all over its body causes earthquake-like tremors. Seismitoad and Croagunk are similar species.

sentret.name: SENTRET
sentret.dex_entry: When Sentret sleeps, it does so while another stands guard. The sentry wakes the others at the first sign of danger. When this Pokï¿½mon becomes separated from its pack, it becomes incapable of sleep due to fear.

serperior.name: SERPERIOR
serperior.dex_entry: It only gives its all against strong opponents who are not fazed by the glare from Serperior's noble eyes.

servine.name: SERVINE
servine.dex_entry: It moves along the ground as if sliding. Its swift movements befuddle its foes, and it then attacks with a vine whip.

seviper.name: SEVIPER
seviper.dex_entry: Seviper shares a generations-long feud with Zangoose. The scars on its body are evidence of vicious battles. This Pokï¿½mon attacks using its sword-edged tail.

sewaddle.name: SEWADDLE
sewaddle.dex_entry: This Pokï¿½mon makes clothes for itself. It chews up leaves and sews them with sticky thread extruded from its mouth.

sharpedo.name: SHARPEDO
sharpedo.dex_entry: As soon as it catches the scent of prey, Sharpedo will jet seawater from its backside, hurtling toward the target to attack at 75 mph.

shaymin.name: SHAYMIN
shaymin.dex_entry: It can dissolve toxins in the air to instantly transform ruined land into a lush field of flowers.

shedinja.name: SHEDINJA
shedinja.dex_entry: A most peculiar Pokï¿½mon that somehow appears in a Pokï¿½ Ball when a Nincada evolves.

shelgon.name: SHELGON
shelgon.dex_entry: The cells within its shell transform with explosive speed, preparing it for evolution.

shellder.name: SHELLDER
shellder.dex_entry: It swims facing backward by opening and closing its two-piece shell. It is surprisingly fast.

shelmet.name: SHELMET
shelmet.dex_entry: When attacked, it tightly shuts the lid of its shell. This reaction fails to protect it from Karrablast, however, because they can still get into the shell.

shieldon.name: SHIELDON
shieldon.dex_entry: Many fossils of this Pokï¿½mon have been found, but almost none have shown signs of damage to the face.

shiftry.name: SHIFTRY
shiftry.dex_entry: A Pokï¿½mon that was feared as a forest guardian. It can read the foe's mind and take preemptive action.

shiinotic.name: SHIINOTIC
shiinotic.dex_entry: Its flickering spores lure in prey and put them to sleep. Once this Pokï¿½mon has its prey snoozing, it drains their vitality with its fingertips.

shinx.name: SHINX
shinx.dex_entry: This Pokï¿½mon generates electricity by contracting its muscles. Excited trembling is a sign that Shinx is generating a tremendous amount of electricity.

shroomish.name: SHROOMISH
shroomish.dex_entry: Shroomish live in damp soil in the dark depths of forests. They are often found keeping still under fallen leaves. This Pokï¿½mon feeds on compost that is made up of fallen, rotted leaves.

shuckle.name: SHUCKLE
shuckle.dex_entry: It stores berries inside its shell. To avoid attacks, it hides beneath rocks and remains completely still.

shuppet.name: SHUPPET
shuppet.dex_entry: Shuppet is attracted by feelings of jealousy and vindictiveness. If someone develops strong feelings of vengeance, this Pokï¿½mon will appear in a swarm and line up beneath the eaves of that person's home.

sigilyph.name: SIGILYPH
sigilyph.dex_entry: Psychic power allows these Pokï¿½mon to fly. Some say they were the guardians of an ancient city. Others say they were the guardians' emissaries.

silcoon.name: SILCOON
silcoon.dex_entry: Silcoon tethers itself to a tree branch using silk to keep from falling. There, this Pokï¿½mon hangs quietly while it awaits evolution. It peers out of the silk cocoon through a small hole.

silicobra.name: SILICOBRA
silicobra.dex_entry: As it digs, it swallows sand and stores it in its neck pouch. The pouch can hold more than 17 pounds of sand.

silvally.name: SILVALLY
silvally.dex_entry: A solid bond of trust between this Pokï¿½mon and its Trainer awakened the strength hidden within Silvally. It can change its type at will.

simipour.name: SIMIPOUR
simipour.dex_entry: The high-pressure water expelled from its tail is so powerful, it can destroy a concrete wall.

simisage.name: SIMISAGE
simisage.dex_entry: It attacks enemies with strikes of its thorn-covered tail. This Pokï¿½mon is wild tempered.

simisear.name: SIMISEAR
simisear.dex_entry: A flame burns inside its body. It scatters embers from its head and tail to sear its opponents.

sinistea.name: SINISTEA
sinistea.dex_entry: The swirl pattern in this Pokï¿½mon's body is its weakness. If it gets stirred, the swirl loses its shape, and Sinistea gets dizzy.

sirfetch_d.name: SIRFETCH D
sirfetch_d.dex_entry: Only Farfetch'd that have survived many battles can attain this evolution. When this Pokï¿½mon's leek withers, it will retire from combat.

sizzlipede.name: SIZZLIPEDE
sizzlipede.dex_entry: It stores flammable gas in its body and uses it to generate heat. The yellow sections on its belly get particularly hot.

skarmory.name: SKARMORY
skarmory.dex_entry: The pointed feathers of these Pokï¿½mon are sharper than swords. Skarmory and Corviknight fight viciously over territory.

skiddo.name: SKIDDO
skiddo.dex_entry: Thought to be one of the first Pokï¿½mon to live in harmony with humans, it has a placid disposition.

skiploom.name: SKIPLOOM
skiploom.dex_entry: Skiploom's flower blossoms when the temperature rises above 64 degrees Fahrenheit. How much the flower opens depends on the temperature. For that reason, this Pokï¿½mon is sometimes used as a thermometer.

skitty.name: SKITTY
skitty.dex_entry: Skitty has the habit of becoming fascinated by moving objects and chasing them around. This Pokï¿½mon is known to chase after its own tail and become dizzy.

skorupi.name: SKORUPI
skorupi.dex_entry: After burrowing into the sand, it waits patiently for prey to come near. This Pokï¿½mon and Sizzlipede share common descent.

skrelp.name: SKRELP
skrelp.dex_entry: It drifts in the ocean, blending in with floating seaweed. When other Pokï¿½mon come to feast on the seaweed, Skrelp feasts on them instead.

skuntank.name: SKUNTANK
skuntank.dex_entry: In its belly, it reserves stinky fluid that it shoots from its tail during battle. As this Pokï¿½mon's diet varies, so does the stench of its fluid.

skwovet.name: SKWOVET
skwovet.dex_entry: Found throughout the Galar region, this Pokï¿½mon becomes uneasy if its cheeks are ever completely empty of berries.

slaking.name: SLAKING
slaking.dex_entry: Slaking spends all day lying down and lolling about. It eats grass growing within its reach. If it eats all the grass it can reach, this Pokï¿½mon reluctantly moves to another spot.

slakoth.name: SLAKOTH
slakoth.dex_entry: Slakoth lolls around for over 20 hours every day. Because it moves so little, it does not need much food. This Pokï¿½mon's sole daily meal consists of just three leaves.

sliggoo.name: SLIGGOO
sliggoo.dex_entry: Although this Pokï¿½mon isn't very strong, its body is coated in a caustic slime that can melt through anything, so predators steer clear of it.

slowbro.name: SLOWBRO
slowbro.dex_entry: A Shellder bite set off a chemical reaction with the spices inside Slowbro's body, causing Slowbro to become a Poison-type Pokï¿½mon.

slowking.name: SLOWKING
slowking.dex_entry: Miraculously, this former Slowpoke's latent intelligence was drawn out when Shellder poison raced through its brain.

slowpoke.name: SLOWPOKE
slowpoke.dex_entry: Although this Pokï¿½mon is normally zoned out, its expression abruptly sharpens on occasion. The cause for this seems to lie in Slowpoke's diet.

slugma.name: SLUGMA
slugma.dex_entry: Molten magma courses throughout Slugma's circulatory system. If this Pokï¿½mon is chilled, the magma cools and hardens. Its body turns brittle and chunks fall off, reducing its size.

slurpuff.name: SLURPUFF
slurpuff.dex_entry: By taking in a person's scent, it can sniff out their mental and physical condition. It's hoped that this skill will have many medical applications.

smeargle.name: SMEARGLE
smeargle.dex_entry: The unique creations produced by each Smeargle are painted using the fluid that oozes from its tail. This is how it marks its territory.

smoochum.name: SMOOCHUM
smoochum.dex_entry: Smoochum actively runs about, but also falls quite often. Whenever the chance arrives, it will look for its reflection to make sure its face hasn't become dirty.

sneasel.name: SNEASEL
sneasel.dex_entry: Its paws conceal sharp claws. If attacked, it suddenly extends the claws and startles its enemy.

snivy.name: SNIVY
snivy.dex_entry: Being exposed to sunlight makes its movements swifter. It uses vines more adeptly than its hands.

snom.name: SNOM
snom.dex_entry: It spits out thread imbued with a frigid sort of energy and uses it to tie its body to branches, disguising itself as an icicle while it sleeps.

snorlax.name: SNORLAX
snorlax.dex_entry: Gigantamax energy has affected stray seeds and even pebbles that got stuck to Snorlax, making them grow to a huge size.

snorunt.name: SNORUNT
snorunt.dex_entry: It's said that if they are seen at midnight, they'll cause heavy snow. They eat snow and ice to survive.

snover.name: SNOVER
snover.dex_entry: It lives on snowy mountains. It sinks its legs into the snow to absorb water and keep its own temperature down.

snubbull.name: SNUBBULL
snubbull.dex_entry: Despite its intimidating face, it's quite cowardly. Its desperate attempts to appear threatening make it popular with people.

sobble.name: SOBBLE
sobble.dex_entry: When scared, this Pokï¿½mon cries. Its tears pack the chemical punch of 100 onions, and attackers won't be able to resist weeping.

solgaleo.name: SOLGALEO
solgaleo.dex_entry: When light radiates from its body, this Pokï¿½mon could almost appear to be the sun. It will dispel any darkness and light up the world.

solosis.name: SOLOSIS
solosis.dex_entry: It communicates with others telepathically. Its body is encapsulated in liquid, but if it takes a heavy blow, the liquid will leak out.

solrock.name: SOLROCK
solrock.dex_entry: When it rotates itself, it gives off light similar to the sun, thus blinding its foes.

spearow.name: SPEAROW
spearow.dex_entry: Its short wings make it inept at flying. It moves about hurriedly and pecks at Bug-type Pokï¿½mon in the tall grass.

spectrier.name: SPECTRIER
spectrier.dex_entry: It probes its surroundings with all its senses save oneï¿½it doesn't use its sense of sight. Spectrier's kicks are said to separate soul from body.

spewpa.name: SPEWPA
spewpa.dex_entry: It lives hidden within thicket shadows. When predators attack, it quickly bristles the fur covering its body in an effort to threaten them.

spheal.name: SPHEAL
spheal.dex_entry: Spheal is much faster rolling than walking to get around. When groups of this Pokï¿½mon eat, they all clap at once to show their pleasure. Because of this, their mealtimes are noisy.

spinarak.name: SPINARAK
spinarak.dex_entry: It waits intently until its preferred prey, Cutiefly, gets caught in its web. In fact, it's quite a patient Pokï¿½mon.

spinda.name: SPINDA
spinda.dex_entry: Its steps are staggering and unsteady, but Spinda thinks it's walking in a straight line.

spiritomb.name: SPIRITOMB
spiritomb.dex_entry: A Pokï¿½mon that was formed by 108 spirits. It is bound to a fissure in an odd keystone.

spoink.name: SPOINK
spoink.dex_entry: Spoink bounces around on its tail. The shock of its bouncing makes its heart pump. As a result, this Pokï¿½mon cannot afford to stop bouncingï¿½if it stops, its heart will stop.

spritzee.name: SPRITZEE
spritzee.dex_entry: A scent pouch within this Pokï¿½mon's body allows it to create various scents. A change in its diet will alter the fragrance it produces.

squirtle.name: SQUIRTLE
squirtle.dex_entry: When it retracts its long neck into its shell, it squirts out water with vigorous force.

stantler.name: STANTLER
stantler.dex_entry: Stantler's magnificent antlers were traded at high prices as works of art. As a result, this Pokï¿½mon was hunted close to extinction by those who were after the priceless antlers.

staraptor.name: STARAPTOR
staraptor.dex_entry: The muscles in its wings and legs are strong. It can easily fly while gripping a small Pokï¿½mon.

staravia.name: STARAVIA
staravia.dex_entry: They maintain huge flocks, although fierce scuffles break out between various flocks.

starly.name: STARLY
starly.dex_entry: They flock in great numbers. Though small, they flap their wings with great power.

starmie.name: STARMIE
starmie.dex_entry: This Pokï¿½mon has an organ known as its core. The organ glows in seven colors when Starmie is unleashing its potent psychic powers.

staryu.name: STARYU
staryu.dex_entry: If you visit a beach at the end of summer, you'll be able to see groups of Staryu lighting up in a steady rhythm.

steelix.name: STEELIX
steelix.dex_entry: It is said that if an Onix lives for over 100 years, its composition changes to become diamond-like.

steenee.name: STEENEE
steenee.dex_entry: As it twirls like a dancer, a sweet smell spreads out around it. Anyone who inhales the scent will feel a surge of happiness.

stonjourner.name: STONJOURNER
stonjourner.dex_entry: It stands in grasslands, watching the sun's descent from zenith to horizon. This Pokï¿½mon has a talent for delivering dynamic kicks.

stoutland.name: STOUTLAND
stoutland.dex_entry: These Pokï¿½mon seem to enjoy living with humans. Even a Stoutland caught in the wild will warm up to people in about three days.

stufful.name: STUFFUL
stufful.dex_entry: Its fluffy fur is a delight to pet, but carelessly reaching out to touch this Pokï¿½mon could result in painful retaliation.

stunfisk.name: STUNFISK
stunfisk.dex_entry: Living in mud with a high iron content has given it a strong steel body.

stunky.name: STUNKY
stunky.dex_entry: From its rear, it sprays a foul-smelling liquid at opponents. It aims for their faces, and it can hit them from over 16 feet away.

sudowoodo.name: SUDOWOODO
sudowoodo.dex_entry: If a tree branch shakes when there is no wind, it's a Sudowoodo, not a tree. It hides from the rain.

suicune.name: SUICUNE
suicune.dex_entry: Suicune embodies the compassion of a pure spring of water. It runs across the land with gracefulness. This Pokï¿½mon has the power to purify dirty water.

sunflora.name: SUNFLORA
sunflora.dex_entry: Sunflora converts solar energy into nutrition. It moves around actively in the daytime when it is warm. It stops moving as soon as the sun goes down for the night.

sunkern.name: SUNKERN
sunkern.dex_entry: Sunkern tries to move as little as it possibly can. It does so because it tries to conserve all the nutrients it has stored in its body for its evolution. It will not eat a thing, subsisting only on morning dew.

surskit.name: SURSKIT
surskit.dex_entry: It moves as if skating on the surface of the water. It often fights with Dewpider over food.

swablu.name: SWABLU
swablu.dex_entry: Swablu has light and fluffy wings that are like cottony clouds. This Pokï¿½mon is not frightened of people. It lands on the heads of people and sits there like a cotton-fluff hat.

swadloon.name: SWADLOON
swadloon.dex_entry: Forests where Swadloon live have superb foliage because the nutrients they make from fallen leaves nourish the plant life.

swalot.name: SWALOT
swalot.dex_entry: When Swalot spots prey, it spurts out a hideously toxic fluid from its pores and sprays the target. Once the prey has weakened, this Pokï¿½mon gulps it down whole with its cavernous mouth.

swampert.name: SWAMPERT
swampert.dex_entry: Swampert is very strong. It has enough power to easily drag a boulder weighing more than a ton. This Pokï¿½mon also has powerful vision that lets it see even in murky water.

swanna.name: SWANNA
swanna.dex_entry: Despite their elegant appearance, they can flap their wings strongly and fly for thousands of miles.

swellow.name: SWELLOW
swellow.dex_entry: Swellow flies high above our heads, making graceful arcs in the sky. This Pokï¿½mon dives at a steep angle as soon as it spots its prey. The hapless prey is tightly grasped by Swellow's clawed feet, preventing escape.

swinub.name: SWINUB
swinub.dex_entry: It rubs its snout on the ground to find and dig up food. It sometimes discovers hot springs.

swirlix.name: SWIRLIX
swirlix.dex_entry: It eats its own weight in sugar every day. If it doesn't get enough sugar, it becomes incredibly grumpy.

swoobat.name: SWOOBAT
swoobat.dex_entry: Emitting powerful sound waves tires it out. Afterward, it won't be able to fly for a little while.

sylveon.name: SYLVEON
sylveon.dex_entry: By releasing enmity-erasing waves from its ribbonlike feelers, Sylveon stops any conflict.

taillow.name: TAILLOW
taillow.dex_entry: Taillow courageously stands its ground against foes, however strong they may be. This gutsy Pokï¿½mon will remain defiant even after a loss. On the other hand, it cries loudly if it becomes hungry.

talonflame.name: TALONFLAME
talonflame.dex_entry: Talonflame mainly preys upon other bird Pokï¿½mon. To intimidate opponents, it sends embers spewing from gaps between its feathers.

tangela.name: TANGELA
tangela.dex_entry: Hidden beneath a tangle of vines that grows nonstop even if the vines are torn off, this Pokï¿½mon's true appearance remains a mystery.

tangrowth.name: TANGROWTH
tangrowth.dex_entry: Tangrowth has two arms that it can extend as it pleases. Recent research has shown that these arms are, in fact, bundles of vines.

tapu_bulu.name: TAPU BULU
tapu_bulu.dex_entry: It pulls large trees up by the roots and swings them around. It causes vegetation to grow, and then it absorbs energy from the growth.

tapu_fini.name: TAPU FINI
tapu_fini.dex_entry: The dense fog it creates brings the downfall and destruction of its confused enemies. Ocean currents are the source of its energy.

tapu_koko.name: TAPU KOKO
tapu_koko.dex_entry: This guardian deity of Melemele is brimming with curiosity. It summons thunderclouds and stores their lightning inside its body.

tapu_lele.name: TAPU LELE
tapu_lele.dex_entry: This guardian deity of Akala is guilelessly cruel. The fragrant aroma of flowers is the source of its energy.

tauros.name: TAUROS
tauros.dex_entry: When Tauros begins whipping itself with its tails, it's a warning that the Pokï¿½mon is about to charge with astounding speed.

teddiursa.name: TEDDIURSA
teddiursa.dex_entry: This Pokï¿½mon likes to lick its palms that are sweetened by being soaked in honey. Teddiursa concocts its own honey by blending fruits and pollen collected by Beedrill.

tentacool.name: TENTACOOL
tentacool.dex_entry: Tentacool is not a particularly strong swimmer. It drifts across the surface of shallow seas as it searches for prey.

tentacruel.name: TENTACRUEL
tentacruel.dex_entry: When the red orbs on Tentacruel's head glow brightly, watch out. The Pokï¿½mon is about to fire off a burst of ultrasonic waves.

tepig.name: TEPIG
tepig.dex_entry: It can deftly dodge its foe's attacks while shooting fireballs from its nose. It roasts berries before it eats them.

terrakion.name: TERRAKION
terrakion.dex_entry: Its charge is strong enough to break through a giant castle wall in one blow. This Pokï¿½mon is spoken of in legends.

thievul.name: THIEVUL
thievul.dex_entry: It secretly marks potential targets with a scent. By following the scent, it stalks its targets and steals from them when they least expect it.

throh.name: THROH
throh.dex_entry: It performs throwing moves with first-rate skill. Over the course of many battles, Throh's belt grows darker as it absorbs its wearer's sweat.

thundurus.name: THUNDURUS
thundurus.dex_entry: The spikes on its tail discharge immense bolts of lightning. It flies around the Unova region firing off lightning bolts.

thwackey.name: THWACKEY
thwackey.dex_entry: The faster a Thwackey can beat out a rhythm with its two sticks, the more respect it wins from its peers.

timburr.name: TIMBURR
timburr.dex_entry: It loves helping out with construction projects. It loves it so much that if rain causes work to halt, it swings its log around and throws a tantrum.

tirtouga.name: TIRTOUGA
tirtouga.dex_entry: Based on studies of its skeletal structure, it can apparently dive to ocean depths of over half a mile.

togedemaru.name: TOGEDEMARU
togedemaru.dex_entry: With the long hairs on its back, this Pokï¿½mon takes in electricity from other electric Pokï¿½mon. It stores what it absorbs in an electric sac.

togekiss.name: TOGEKISS
togekiss.dex_entry: These Pokï¿½mon are never seen anywhere near conflict or turmoil. In recent times, they've hardly been seen at all.

togepi.name: TOGEPI
togepi.dex_entry: The shell seems to be filled with joy. It is said that it will share good luck when treated kindly.

togetic.name: TOGETIC
togetic.dex_entry: They say that it will appear before kindhearted, caring people and shower them with happiness.

torchic.name: TORCHIC
torchic.dex_entry: Torchic sticks with its Trainer, following behind with unsteady steps. This Pokï¿½mon breathes fire of over 1,800 degrees Fahrenheit, including fireballs that leave the foe scorched black.

torkoal.name: TORKOAL
torkoal.dex_entry: It burns coal inside its shell for energy. It blows out black soot if it is endangered.

tornadus.name: TORNADUS
tornadus.dex_entry: The lower half of its body is wrapped in a cloud of energy. It zooms through the sky at 200 mph.

torracat.name: TORRACAT
torracat.dex_entry: In the midst of battle, the fire pouch on Torracat's neck rings like a bell and produces stronger flames than usual.

torterra.name: TORTERRA
torterra.dex_entry: Ancient people imagined that beneath the ground, a gigantic Torterra dwelled.

totodile.name: TOTODILE
totodile.dex_entry: Despite the smallness of its body, Totodile's jaws are very powerful. While the Pokï¿½mon may think it is just playfully nipping, its bite has enough power to cause serious injury.

toucannon.name: TOUCANNON
toucannon.dex_entry: When it battles, its beak heats up. The temperature can easily exceed 212 degrees Fahrenheit, causing severe burns when it hits.

toxapex.name: TOXAPEX
toxapex.dex_entry: To survive in the cold waters of Galar, this Pokï¿½mon forms a dome with its legs, enclosing its body so it can capture its own body heat.

toxel.name: TOXEL
toxel.dex_entry: It stores poison in an internal poison sac and secretes that poison through its skin. If you touch this Pokï¿½mon, a tingling sensation follows.

toxicroak.name: TOXICROAK
toxicroak.dex_entry: It bounces toward opponents and gouges them with poisonous claws. No more than a scratch is needed to knock out its adversaries.

toxtricity_amped.name: TOXTRICITY AMPED
toxtricity_amped.dex_entry: When this Pokï¿½mon sounds as if it's strumming a guitar, itï¿½s actually clawing at the protrusions on its chest to generate electricity.

toxtricity_lowkey.name: TOXTRICITY LOWKEY
toxtricity_lowkey.dex_entry: Capable of generating 15,000 volts of electricity, this Pokï¿½mon looks down on all that would challenge it.

tranquill.name: TRANQUILL
tranquill.dex_entry: It can fly moderately quickly. No matter how far it travels, it can always find its way back to its master and its nest.

trapinch.name: TRAPINCH
trapinch.dex_entry: Its nest is a sloped, bowl-like pit in the desert. Once something has fallen in, there is no escape.

treecko.name: TREECKO
treecko.dex_entry: Treecko has small hooks on the bottom of its feet that enable it to scale vertical walls. This Pokï¿½mon attacks by slamming foes with its thick tail.

trevenant.name: TREVENANT
trevenant.dex_entry: People fear it due to a belief that it devours any who try to cut down trees in its forest, but to the Pokï¿½mon it shares its woods with, it's kind.

tropius.name: TROPIUS
tropius.dex_entry: The bunches of fruit around Tropius's neck are very popular with children. This Pokï¿½mon loves fruit, and eats it continuously. Apparently, its love for fruit resulted in its own outgrowth of fruit.

trubbish.name: TRUBBISH
trubbish.dex_entry: Its favorite places are unsanitary ones. If you leave trash lying around, you could even find one of these Pokï¿½mon living in your room.

trumbeak.name: TRUMBEAK
trumbeak.dex_entry: It eats berries and stores their seeds in its beak. When it encounters enemies or prey, it fires off all the seeds in a burst.

tsareena.name: TSAREENA
tsareena.dex_entry: This feared Pokï¿½mon has long, slender legs and a cruel heart. It shows no mercy as it stomps on its opponents.

turtonator.name: TURTONATOR
turtonator.dex_entry: Explosive substances coat the shell on its back. Enemies that dare attack it will be blown away by an immense detonation.

turtwig.name: TURTWIG
turtwig.dex_entry: Photosynthesis occurs across its body under the sun. The shell on its back is actually hardened soil.

tympole.name: TYMPOLE
tympole.dex_entry: Graceful ripples running across the water's surface are a sure sign that Tympole are singing in high-pitched voices below.

tynamo.name: TYNAMO
tynamo.dex_entry: While one alone doesn't have much power, a chain of many Tynamo can be as powerful as lightning.

typhlosion.name: TYPHLOSION
typhlosion.dex_entry: Typhlosion obscures itself behind a shimmering heat haze that it creates using its intensely hot flames. This Pokï¿½mon creates blazing explosive blasts that burn everything to cinders.

typhlosion_hisuian.name: TYPHLOSION HISUIAN
typhlosion_hisuian.dex_entry: Typhlosion obscures itself behind a shimmering heat haze that it creates using its intensely hot flames. This Pokï¿½mon creates blazing explosive blasts that burn everything to cinders.

tyranitar.name: TYRANITAR
tyranitar.dex_entry: Its body can't be harmed by any sort of attack, so it is very eager to make challenges against enemies.

tyrantrum.name: TYRANTRUM
tyrantrum.dex_entry: Thanks to its gargantuan jaws, which could shred thick metal plates as if they were paper, it was invincible in the ancient world it once inhabited.

tyrogue.name: TYROGUE
tyrogue.dex_entry: It is always bursting with energy. To make itself stronger, it keeps on fighting even if it loses.

tyrunt.name: TYRUNT
tyrunt.dex_entry: This Pokï¿½mon was restored from a fossil. If something happens that it doesn't like, it throws a tantrum and runs wild.

umbreon.name: UMBREON
umbreon.dex_entry: When this Pokï¿½mon becomes angry, its pores secrete a poisonous sweat, which it sprays at its opponent's eyes.

unfezant.name: UNFEZANT
unfezant.dex_entry: Females of this species are very capable fliers, particularly notable for their stamina. They also take longer to adjust to people.

unown.name: UNOWN
unown.dex_entry: This Pokï¿½mon is shaped like ancient writing. It is a mystery as to which came first, the ancient writings or the various Unown. Research into this topic is ongoing but nothing is known.

ursaluna.name: URSALUNA
ursaluna.dex_entry: In the forests inhabited by Ursaring, it is said that there are many streams and towering trees where they gather food. This Pokï¿½mon walks through its forest gathering food every day.

ursaring.name: URSARING
ursaring.dex_entry: In the forests inhabited by Ursaring, it is said that there are many streams and towering trees where they gather food. This Pokï¿½mon walks through its forest gathering food every day.

urshifu_rapidstrike.name: URSHIFU RAPIDSTRIKE
urshifu_rapidstrike.dex_entry: It's believed that this Pokï¿½mon modeled its fighting style on the flow of a riverï¿½sometimes rapid, sometimes calm.

urshifu_singlestrike.name: URSHIFU SINGLESTRIKE
urshifu_singlestrike.dex_entry: This form of Urshifu is a strong believer in the one-hit KO. Its strategy is to leap in close to foes and land a devastating blow with a hardened fist.

uxie.name: UXIE
uxie.dex_entry: Known as ï¿½The Being of Knowledge.ï¿½ It is said that it can wipe out the memory of those who see its eyes.

vanillish.name: VANILLISH
vanillish.dex_entry: By drinking pure water, it grows its icy body. This Pokï¿½mon can be hard to find on days with warm, sunny weather.

vanillite.name: VANILLITE
vanillite.dex_entry: Unable to survive in hot areas, it makes itself comfortable by breathing out air cold enough to cause snow. It burrows into the snow to sleep.

vanilluxe.name: VANILLUXE
vanilluxe.dex_entry: When its anger reaches a breaking point, this Pokï¿½mon unleashes a fierce blizzard that freezes every creature around it, be they friend or foe.

vaporeon.name: VAPOREON
vaporeon.dex_entry: When Vaporeon's fins begin to vibrate, it is a sign that rain will come within a few hours.

venipede.name: VENIPEDE
venipede.dex_entry: Venipede and Sizzlipede are similar species, but when the two meet, a huge fight ensues.

venomoth.name: VENOMOTH
venomoth.dex_entry: Venomoth is nocturnalï¿½it is a Pokï¿½mon that only becomes active at night. Its favorite prey are small insects that gather around streetlights, attracted by the light in the darkness.

venonat.name: VENONAT
venonat.dex_entry: Venonat is said to have evolved with a coat of thin, stiff hair that covers its entire body for protection. It possesses large eyes that never fail to spot even minuscule prey.

venusaur.name: VENUSAUR
venusaur.dex_entry: In battle, this Pokï¿½mon swings around two thick vines. If these vines slammed into a 10-story building, they could easily topple it.

vespiquen.name: VESPIQUEN
vespiquen.dex_entry: It skillfully commands its grubs in battles with its enemies. The grubs are willing to risk their lives to defend Vespiquen.

vibrava.name: VIBRAVA
vibrava.dex_entry: The ultrasonic waves it generates by rubbing its two wings together cause severe headaches.

victini.name: VICTINI
victini.dex_entry: This Pokï¿½mon brings victory. It is said that Trainers with Victini always win, regardless of the type of encounter.

victreebel.name: VICTREEBEL
victreebel.dex_entry: Victreebel has a long vine that extends from its head. This vine is waved and flicked about as if it were an animal to attract prey. When an unsuspecting prey draws near, this Pokï¿½mon swallows it whole.

vigoroth.name: VIGOROTH
vigoroth.dex_entry: Vigoroth is always itching and agitated to go on a wild rampage. It simply can't tolerate sitting still for even a minute. This Pokï¿½mon's stress level rises if it can't be moving constantly.

vikavolt.name: VIKAVOLT
vikavolt.dex_entry: It builds up electricity in its abdomen, focuses it through its jaws, and then fires the electricity off in concentrated beams.

vileplume.name: VILEPLUME
vileplume.dex_entry: It has the world's largest petals. With every step, the petals shake out heavy clouds of toxic pollen.

virizion.name: VIRIZION
virizion.dex_entry: Its head sprouts horns as sharp as blades. Using whirlwind-like movements, it confounds and swiftly cuts opponents.

vivillon.name: VIVILLON
vivillon.dex_entry: Vivillon with many different patterns are found all over the world. These patterns are affected by the climate of their habitat.

volbeat.name: VOLBEAT
volbeat.dex_entry: With the arrival of night, Volbeat emits light from its tail. It communicates with others by adjusting the intensity and flashing of its light. This Pokï¿½mon is attracted by the sweet aroma of Illumise.

volcanion.name: VOLCANION
volcanion.dex_entry: It lets out billows of steam and disappears into the dense fog. It's said to live in mountains where humans do not tread.

volcarona.name: VOLCARONA
volcarona.dex_entry: Volcarona scatters burning scales. Some say it does this to start fires. Others say it's trying to rescue those that suffer in the cold.

voltorb.name: VOLTORB
voltorb.dex_entry: Voltorb was first sighted at a company that manufactures Pokï¿½ Balls. The link between that sighting and the fact that this Pokï¿½mon looks very similar to a Pokï¿½ Ball remains a mystery.

vullaby.name: VULLABY
vullaby.dex_entry: It wears a bone to protect its rear. It often squabbles with others of its kind over particularly comfy bones.

vulpix.name: VULPIX
vulpix.dex_entry: While young, it has six gorgeous tails. When it grows, several new tails are sprouted.

wailmer.name: WAILMER
wailmer.dex_entry: It shows off by spraying jets of seawater from the nostrils above its eyes. It eats a solid ton of Wishiwashi every day.

wailord.name: WAILORD
wailord.dex_entry: It can sometimes knock out opponents with the shock created by breaching and crashing its big body onto the water.

walrein.name: WALREIN
walrein.dex_entry: Walrein's two massively developed tusks can totally shatter blocks of ice weighing 10 tons with one blow. This Pokï¿½mon's thick coat of blubber insulates it from subzero temperatures.

wartortle.name: WARTORTLE
wartortle.dex_entry: It is recognized as a symbol of longevity. If its shell has algae on it, that Wartortle is very old.

watchog.name: WATCHOG
watchog.dex_entry: Using luminescent matter, it makes its eyes and body glow and stuns attacking opponents.

weavile.name: WEAVILE
weavile.dex_entry: They attack their quarry in packs. Prey as large as Mamoswine easily fall to the teamwork of a group of Weavile.

weedle.name: WEEDLE
weedle.dex_entry: Weedle has an extremely acute sense of smell. It is capable of distinguishing its favorite kinds of leaves from those it dislikes just by sniffing with its big red proboscis (nose).

weepinbell.name: WEEPINBELL
weepinbell.dex_entry: Weepinbell has a large hook on its rear end. At night, the Pokï¿½mon hooks on to a tree branch and goes to sleep. If it moves around in its sleep, it may wake up to find itself on the ground.

weezing.name: WEEZING
weezing.dex_entry: It mixes gases between its two bodies. It's said that these Pokï¿½mon were seen all over the Galar region back in the day.

whimsicott.name: WHIMSICOTT
whimsicott.dex_entry: It scatters cotton all over the place as a prank. If it gets wet, it'll become too heavy to move and have no choice but to answer for its mischief.

whirlipede.name: WHIRLIPEDE
whirlipede.dex_entry: This Pokï¿½mon spins itself rapidly and charges into its opponents. Its top speed is just over 60 mph.

whiscash.name: WHISCASH
whiscash.dex_entry: It makes its nest at the bottom of swamps. It will eat anythingï¿½if it is alive, Whiscash will eat it.

whismur.name: WHISMUR
whismur.dex_entry: The cry of a Whismur is over 100 decibels. If you're close to a Whismur when it lets out a cry, you'll be stuck with an all-day headache.

wigglytuff.name: WIGGLYTUFF
wigglytuff.dex_entry: The more air it takes in, the more it inflates. If opponents catch it in a bad mood, it will inflate itself to an enormous size to intimidate them.

wimpod.name: WIMPOD
wimpod.dex_entry: It's nature's cleanerï¿½it eats anything and everything, including garbage and rotten things. The ground near its nest is always clean.

wingull.name: WINGULL
wingull.dex_entry: It makes its nest on sheer cliffs. Riding the sea breeze, it glides up into the expansive skies.

wishiwashi.name: WISHIWASHI
wishiwashi.dex_entry: Individually, they're incredibly weak. It's by gathering up into schools that they're able to confront opponents.

wobbuffet.name: WOBBUFFET
wobbuffet.dex_entry: It hates light and shock. If attacked, it inflates its body to pump up its counterstrike.

woobat.name: WOOBAT
woobat.dex_entry: While inside a cave, if you look up and see lots of heart-shaped marks lining the walls, it's evidence that Woobat live there.

wooloo.name: WOOLOO
wooloo.dex_entry: Its curly fleece is such an effective cushion that this Pokï¿½mon could fall off a cliff and stand right back up at the bottom, unharmed.

wooper.name: WOOPER
wooper.dex_entry: This Pokï¿½mon lives in cold water. It will leave the water to search for food when it gets cold outside.

wormadam_plant.name: WORMADAM PLANT
wormadam_plant.dex_entry: Its appearance changes depending on where it evolved. The materials on hand become a part of its body.

wormadam_sand.name: WORMADAM SAND
wormadam_sand.dex_entry: Its appearance changes depending on where it evolved. The materials on hand become a part of its body.

wormadam_trash.name: WORMADAM TRASH
wormadam_trash.dex_entry: Its appearance changes depending on where it evolved. The materials on hand become a part of its body.

wurmple.name: WURMPLE
wurmple.dex_entry: Using the spikes on its rear end, Wurmple peels the bark off trees and feeds on the sap that oozes out. This Pokï¿½mon's feet are tipped with suction pads that allow it to cling to glass without slipping.

wynaut.name: WYNAUT
wynaut.dex_entry: It tends to move in a pack. Individuals squash against one another to toughen their spirits.

xatu.name: XATU
xatu.dex_entry: They say that it stays still and quiet because it is seeing both the past and future at the same time.

xerneas.name: XERNEAS
xerneas.dex_entry: Legends say it can share eternal life. It slept for a thousand years in the form of a tree before its revival.

xurkitree.name: XURKITREE
xurkitree.dex_entry: One of the mysterious life-forms known as Ultra Beasts. Astonishing electric shocks emanate from its entire body, according to witnesses.

yamask.name: YAMASK
yamask.dex_entry: A clay slab with cursed engravings took possession of a Yamask. The slab is said to be absorbing the Yamask's dark power.

yamask_galarian.name: YAMASK GALARIAN
yamask_galarian.dex_entry: A clay slab with cursed engravings took possession of a Yamask. The slab is said to be absorbing the Yamask's dark power.

yamper.name: YAMPER
yamper.dex_entry: This Pokï¿½mon is very popular as a herding dog in the Galar region. As it runs, it generates electricity from the base of its tail.

yanma.name: YANMA
yanma.dex_entry: Yanma is capable of seeing 360 degrees without having to move its eyes. It is a great flier that is adept at making sudden stops and turning midair. This Pokï¿½mon uses its flying ability to quickly chase down targeted prey.

yanmega.name: YANMEGA
yanmega.dex_entry: It prefers to battle by biting apart foes' heads instantly while flying by at high speed.

yungoos.name: YUNGOOS
yungoos.dex_entry: With its sharp fangs, it will bite anything. It did not originally live in Alola but was imported from another region.

yveltal.name: YVELTAL
yveltal.dex_entry: When this legendary Pokï¿½mon's wings and tail feathers spread wide and glow red, it absorbs the life force of living creatures.

zacian.name: ZACIAN
zacian.dex_entry: Known as a legendary hero, this Pokï¿½mon absorbs metal particles, transforming them into a weapon it uses to battle.

zamazenta.name: ZAMAZENTA
zamazenta.dex_entry: In times past, it worked together with a king of the people to save the Galar region. It absorbs metal that it then uses in battle.

zangoose.name: ZANGOOSE
zangoose.dex_entry: Memories of battling its archrival Seviper are etched into every cell of Zangoose's body. This Pokï¿½mon adroitly dodges attacks with incredible agility.

zapdos.name: ZAPDOS
zapdos.dex_entry: Zapdos is a legendary bird Pokï¿½mon that has the ability to control electricity. It usually lives in thunderclouds. The Pokï¿½mon gains power if it is stricken by lightning bolts.

zarude.name: ZARUDE
zarude.dex_entry: This Zarude left its pack to raise a human child. The cloth Zarude would wrap the child with has a comforting scent that calmed the child's crying.

zebstrika.name: ZEBSTRIKA
zebstrika.dex_entry: When this ill-tempered Pokï¿½mon runs wild, it shoots lightning from its mane in all directions.

zekrom.name: ZEKROM
zekrom.dex_entry: When the interior part of its tail spins like a motor, Zekrom can generate many bolts of lightning to blast its surroundings.

zeraora.name: ZERAORA
zeraora.dex_entry: It runs as fast as lightning strikes, shredding its opponents with its high-voltage claws.

zigzagoon.name: ZIGZAGOON
zigzagoon.dex_entry: It marks its territory by rubbing its bristly fur on trees. This variety of Zigzagoon is friendlier and calmer than the kind native to Galar.

zoroark.name: ZOROARK
zoroark.dex_entry: This Pokï¿½mon cares deeply about others of its kind, and it will conjure terrifying illusions to keep its den and pack safe.

zorua.name: ZORUA
zorua.dex_entry: Zorua is a timid Pokï¿½mon. This disposition seems to be what led to the development of Zorua's ability to take on the forms of other creatures.

zubat.name: ZUBAT
zubat.dex_entry: It sleeps in caves during the day. It has no eyes, so to check its surroundings while flying, it emits ultrasonic waves.

zweilous.name: ZWEILOUS
zweilous.dex_entry: While hunting for prey, Zweilous wanders its territory, its two heads often bickering over which way to go.

zygarde.name: ZYGARDE
zygarde.dex_entry: This is Zygarde's form when it has gathered 50% of its cells. It wipes out all those who oppose it, showing not a shred of mercy.
